synopsis: かいせつ 電話交換手のアヤ子(山田)は、横領疑惑で失業した父の借金を肩代わりする約束で妻子持ちの会社社長と愛人契約を結ぶが…。溝口が戦前に撮った傑作の１本とされ、活気ある大阪の街並みも、山田のモダンなファッションも見物。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: Ayako becomes the mistress of her boss in order to pay her father's debt and prevent him from going to prison for embezzlement.
synopsis_en: Synopsis: Ayako (Yamada), a telephone operator, enters into a lover's contract with a married company president to cover her father's debts after he loses his job due to embezzlement suspicions... Considered one of Mizoguchi's masterpieces from before the war, the lively streets of Osaka and Yamada's modern fashion are also highlights.

synopsis: かいせつ 敗戦直後の大阪の焼け跡で、娼婦となって生きる女たちの凄まじい生き様を描く。田中と盟友・溝口による数々の名作の中でも、溝口の冷徹な演出と、街娼に身を落とす戦争未亡人役の田中の熱演が鮮烈な印象を残す衝撃作。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 敗戦後の大阪。結核で息子を失った大和田和子のもとに、夫の訃報がもたらされる。和子は会社社長の栗山の秘書となった。和子の妹の夏子はダンサーをしながら和子を捜しており、二人は偶然心斎橋で再会。夏子は和子のアパートで暮らすことになった。和子は栗山に身を任せていたが、ある日、栗山と夏子の関係に気づく。和子は男に復讐するため、アパートを出て売春婦になった。和子を捜すため心斎橋近辺を歩いていた夏子は、売春婦と間違われ警察に検挙されてしまう。
tmdb_overview_en: In early post-war Osaka, three women—war widow Fusako, her Korean expat sister Natsuko, and Kumiko, Fusako's sister-in-law—descend into prostitution, all for their individual reasons.
synopsis_en: Synopsis: A shocking work depicting the fierce struggle for survival of women who become prostitutes in the burnt-out ruins of Osaka immediately after Japan's defeat. Among the many masterpieces by Tanaka and her ally Mizoguchi, this film leaves a vivid impression with Mizoguchi's cold-hearted direction and Tanaka's passionate performance as a war widow forced into street prostitution.

synopsis: かいせつ 京都・島原遊郭の老舗置屋“井筒屋”を営む母に、破談で傷つき帰郷した娘は強く反発する…。母と娘の葛藤を軸に、花街で生きるしかない女たちの悲哀を描いた名作。戦前から長く溝口映画を支えた水谷浩の美術も圧巻。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 東京でトラウマを抱えた雪子は、母・初子が遊郭を経営する京都に戻る。
tmdb_overview_en: After living a traumatic experience in Tokyo, Yukiko returns to Kyoto, where Hatsuko, her mother, runs a brothel, which upsets Yukiko very much.
synopsis_en: A commentary: A daughter returns to Kyoto's Shimabara pleasure district, wounded after a broken engagement, and strongly resists her mother, who runs the long-established geisha house "Izutsuya." This masterpiece centers on the mother-daughter conflict, portraying the sorrow of women who have no choice but to live in the flower and willow world. The art direction by Hiroshi Mizutani, who long supported Mizoguchi's films from before the war, is also stunning.

synopsis: かいせつ 貴族に代わり武士が台頭した平安末期、平清盛は様々な苦難に直面し…。出生の秘密に悩む“人間”清盛を、溝口が圧倒的なスケールで描く歴史劇。デビュー間もない雷蔵が若き清盛を颯爽と演じ、濃艶な母親役の木暮も忘れ難い。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 日本、1137年。鳥羽天皇と比叡山の僧との争いに巻き込まれた武士、平氏。
tmdb_overview_en: Japan, 1137. The Taira family, a samurai clan, becomes involved in the disputes between Emperor Toba and the monks of Mount Hiei.
synopsis_en: A commentary: In the late Heian period, when warriors rose in place of the aristocracy, Taira no Kiyomori faces various hardships... Mizoguchi depicts the "human" Kiyomori, tormented by the secret of his birth, on an overwhelming scale in this historical drama. A young Raizō, early in his debut, plays the youthful Kiyomori with dashing flair, and the unforgettable performance by Kogure as his sensuous mother lingers in the mind.

tmdb_overview_jp: 日本、1137年。鳥羽天皇と比叡山の僧との争いに巻き込まれた武士、平氏。
tmdb_overview_en: Japan, 1137. The Taira family, a samurai clan, becomes involved in the disputes between Emperor Toba and the monks of Mount Hiei.
synopsis_en: A commentary: In the late Heian period, when warriors rose in place of the aristocracy, Taira no Kiyomori faces various hardships... Mizoguchi depicts the "human" Kiyomori, tormented by the secret of his birth, on an overwhelming scale in this historical drama. A young Raizō, early in his debut, plays the youthful Kiyomori with dashing flair, and the unforgettable performance by Kogure as his sensuous mother lingers in the mind.

synopsis: かいせつ 敗戦直後の大阪の焼け跡で、娼婦となって生きる女たちの凄まじい生き様を描く。田中と盟友・溝口による数々の名作の中でも、溝口の冷徹な演出と、街娼に身を落とす戦争未亡人役の田中の熱演が鮮烈な印象を残す衝撃作。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 敗戦後の大阪。結核で息子を失った大和田和子のもとに、夫の訃報がもたらされる。和子は会社社長の栗山の秘書となった。和子の妹の夏子はダンサーをしながら和子を捜しており、二人は偶然心斎橋で再会。夏子は和子のアパートで暮らすことになった。和子は栗山に身を任せていたが、ある日、栗山と夏子の関係に気づく。和子は男に復讐するため、アパートを出て売春婦になった。和子を捜すため心斎橋近辺を歩いていた夏子は、売春婦と間違われ警察に検挙されてしまう。
tmdb_overview_en: In early post-war Osaka, three women—war widow Fusako, her Korean expat sister Natsuko, and Kumiko, Fusako's sister-in-law—descend into prostitution, all for their individual reasons.
synopsis_en: Synopsis: A shocking work depicting the fierce struggle for survival of women who become prostitutes in the burnt-out ruins of Osaka immediately after Japan's defeat. Among the many masterpieces by Tanaka and her ally Mizoguchi, this film leaves a vivid impression with Mizoguchi's cold-hearted direction and Tanaka's passionate performance as a war widow forced into street prostitution.

synopsis: かいせつ 京都・島原遊郭の老舗置屋“井筒屋”を営む母に、破談で傷つき帰郷した娘は強く反発する…。母と娘の葛藤を軸に、花街で生きるしかない女たちの悲哀を描いた名作。戦前から長く溝口映画を支えた水谷浩の美術も圧巻。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 東京でトラウマを抱えた雪子は、母・初子が遊郭を経営する京都に戻る。
tmdb_overview_en: After living a traumatic experience in Tokyo, Yukiko returns to Kyoto, where Hatsuko, her mother, runs a brothel, which upsets Yukiko very much.
synopsis_en: A commentary: A daughter returns to Kyoto's Shimabara pleasure district, wounded after a broken engagement, and strongly resists her mother, who runs the long-established geisha house "Izutsuya." This masterpiece centers on the mother-daughter conflict, portraying the sorrow of women who have no choice but to live in the flower and willow world. The art direction by Hiroshi Mizutani, who long supported Mizoguchi's films from before the war, is also stunning.

program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: Ayako becomes the mistress of her boss in order to pay her father's debt and prevent him from going to prison for embezzlement.
synopsis_en: Synopsis: Ayako (Yamada), a telephone operator, enters into a lover's contract with a married company president to cover her father's debts after he loses his job due to embezzlement suspicions... Considered one of Mizoguchi's masterpieces from before the war, the lively streets of Osaka and Yamada's modern fashion are also highlights.

synopsis: かいせつ 妹の縁談相手の男は、見合いに同席した姉に惹かれ…。数々の傑作を生み出し黄金期となる大映での溝口の第一作。名キャメラマン・宮川とも初めて組み、美しい姉妹と一人の男の揺れ動く三角関係を繊細で夢幻的な映像美で描く。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: Shinnosuke is introduced to Shizu as a prospective marriage partner, but he falls in love with her widowed sister Oyu. Convention forbids Oyu to marry because she has to raise her son as the head of her husband's family. Oyu convinces Shinnosuke and Shizu to marry so that she can remain close to Shinnosuke.
synopsis_en: A commentary: The man who is a match for the younger sister becomes drawn to the older sister who sits in on the arranged meeting... This is Mizoguchi's first film at Daiei, which produced numerous masterpieces during its golden age. Collaborating for the first time with the renowned cinematographer Miyagawa, it delicately depicts the shifting love triangle between two beautiful sisters and one man with a dreamlike visual beauty.

synopsis: かいせつ 最愛の妃を亡くした唐の玄宗皇帝が、一人の娘を見初めて…。香港との共同制作となった溝口初のカラー作品は、傾国の美女・楊貴妃の愛と悲運を描いた宮廷絵巻。エキゾチックな衣装と美術を際立たせる抑えた色調が目をひく。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: In 8th-century China, the Emperor grieves the death of his wife. The Yang family wants to provide the Emperor with a consort so that they may consolidate their court influence. General An Lushan finds a distant relative working in their kitchen, whom they groom to present to the Emperor. The Emperor falls in love and she becomes the Princess Yang Kwei-fei. The Yangs are then appointed important ministers, though An Lushan is not given the court position he covets.
synopsis_en: A commentary: Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, grieving the loss of his beloved consort, sets his sights on a young woman... Mizoguchi's first color film, a co-production with Hong Kong, is a courtly tapestry portraying the love and tragic fate of Yang Guifei, the beauty who toppled an empire. The restrained color palette that highlights the exotic costumes and art direction is striking.

synopsis: かいせつ 旧華族の一人娘の雪は、婿養子の夫の放蕩と横暴に苦しめられ…。戦前から在籍した松竹を離れた溝口が新東宝で撮った官能のメロドラマ。雪夫人を演じた木暮の目も眩む濃密なエロスが、溝口独特の耽美的な世界へと誘い込む。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: A young woman takes up her new job as the servant of a noblewoman and soon discovers that underneath her facade of luxury lies great unhappiness.
synopsis_en: A commentary: Yuki, the only daughter of an old aristocratic family, is tormented by the debauchery and tyranny of her husband, who married into the family... This sensual melodrama was shot by Mizoguchi at Shin Toho after he left Shochiku, where he had worked since before the war. The dazzling, dense eroticism of Kogure, who plays Lady Yuki, lures the viewer into Mizoguchi's uniquely decadent world.

tmdb_overview_jp: 映画女優になる夢を抱くモ。しかし、万年エキストラのまま、回ってくる仕事は顔すら映らない端役や死体の役ばかり。ある日、役作りのプチ整形顔がスタッフの目に止まり、かつてのスター俳優マー主演の超大作「白雪姫 血のチャイナタウン」に抜擢された。だがマーは演技も性格も最低最悪。過去の栄光にすがるトラブルメーカーだった。落ちぶれ俳優マーと、底辺から脱しようと奮闘するモン。やがてこの出会いが、2人の人生を大きく変えていく──!!
tmdb_overview_en: A young female actor dreams of becoming famous and building a successful career despite being a stand-in and extra on most sets.
synopsis_en: Mo dreams of becoming a movie actress. But she remains a perpetual extra, and the only roles that come her way are bit parts where her face never even appears, or corpse roles. One day, her minor cosmetic surgery for a role catches the eye of a staff member, and she is selected for the blockbuster "Snow White: Bloody Chinatown," starring former star actor Ma. But Ma is the absolute worst in both acting and personality—a troublemaker clinging to past glory. A washed-up actor Ma, and Mon, fighting to climb out from the bottom. Before long, this encounter will drastically change both of their lives—!!

Director No Yeong-seon, based in France, turns her gaze on three generations of women in her family—her mother living on Ganghwa Island, South Korea, and her grandmother who died in Okinawa during the war—who lived knowing little of each other. Through the universal question, 'Can we mourn those we have no memory of?' she depicts the transmission of war memories in this documentary. Director No, living in France, has a mother who lives on Ganghwa Island where she was born and raised. Her grandmother, during the end of World War II under Japanese colonial rule, followed her Korean lover from Japan to Seoul. The mother and grandmother were separated during the chaos of the Korean War, so the mother has no memory of the grandmother. Director No tentatively calls this grandmother 'Yukiko' and, using the two islands—Ganghwa Island where her mother lives and Okinawa, which Yukiko chose as her final resting place—as settings, intimately portrays the three generations of women while quietly examining the transmission of war memories through the question, 'Can we mourn those we have no memory of?' The film was screened in the International Competition section of the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival in 2019, one of Asia's largest documentary film festivals. It will be shown in August 2026 at Cinema Rise in Jimbocho, Tokyo, as part of the 'Yama-Doc Teiki-bin' program, which screens films related to the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival.

tmdb_overview_jp: 妻を病気で亡くしたティーは工事現場で働きながら一人息子のディッキーを一流私立小学校に通わせている。ディッキーの欲しがる運動靴を拾いに行ったゴミ捨て場で、ティーは緑色のボールを見つける。ティーが持ち帰ったボールから生まれた生物（かどうか不明な物体）をディッキーはミラクル7号と呼んで飼い始める。
tmdb_overview_en: A poor construction worker, who struggles to keep his son in private school, mistakes an orb he finds in a junkjard for a toy which proves to be much, much more once the young boy starts to play with it.
genres: サイエンスフィクション
synopsis_en: Ti, who lost his wife to illness, works at a construction site to send his only son Dicky to a prestigious private elementary school. While retrieving a pair of sneakers Dicky wanted from the garbage dump, Ti finds a green ball. Dicky begins keeping the creature (or is it an object of unknown nature?) that is born from the ball Ti brought home, naming it Miracle 7.

movie_title: シンプル・アクシデント／偶然
tmdb_overview_jp: かつて不当な理由で投獄されたワヒドは、ある偶然によって、自分の人生を奪った看守に出会う。咄嗟に男を拘束し、荒野に穴を掘り埋めようとするが、男は人違いだと言う。実はワヒドは、男の顔を見たことがなかった。男は、本当に復讐の相手なのか？一旦復讐を中断し、同じ男に拷問された友人を訪ねることにするが･･･。
tmdb_overview_en: An unassuming mechanic is reminded of his time in an Iranian prison when he encounters a man he suspects to be his sadistic jailhouse captor.
clean_title_jp: シンプル・アクシデント／偶然
movie_title_jp: シンプル・アクシデント／偶然
synopsis_en: A suspense thriller by Iranian master Jafar Panahi, winner of the Palme d'Or at the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025. It thrillingly and humorously depicts people wrongfully imprisoned seeking revenge. Vahid, once unjustly imprisoned, accidentally encounters a man he believes was his torturer guard. He forcibly restrains the man and digs a hole in the wilderness to bury him, but the man's ID card shows a different name. The man claims it's a case of mistaken identity. Blindfolded during imprisonment, Vahid never saw his torturer's face. Unsure if this is the right man, Vahid pauses revenge and visits a friend who was also tortured by the same guard. Panahi, banned from filmmaking by the Iranian government for opposition activities, drew inspiration from his own two imprisonments and the real voices of cellmates. Having won the Golden Lion at Venice for 'The Circle' and 'No Bears', and the Golden Bear at Berlin for 'Taxi', Panahi achieved the feat of winning top prizes at all three major festivals with this film. A French co-production, it was France's entry for Best International Feature Film at the 98th Academy Awards and received a nomination.

tmdb_overview_jp: 1930年代の上海は、新興の暴力組織、斧頭会が牛耳っていた。猪籠城寨（豚小屋砦）と呼ばれる貧困者アパートにチンピラのシンとその相棒が斧頭会を名乗り恐喝に来た。住人を舐めていたが逆にボコボコにされ、苦し紛れに投げた爆竹で偶然通りかかった斧頭会幹部に怪我をさせてしまう。
tmdb_overview_en: It's the 1940s, and the notorious Axe Gang terrorizes Shanghai. Small-time criminals Sing and Bone hope to join, but they only manage to make lots of very dangerous enemies. Fortunately for them, kung fu masters and hidden strength can be found in unlikely places. Now they just have to take on the entire Axe Gang.
synopsis_en: A wuxia fantasy action film directed by Taiwanese director Giddens Ko of 'The Secrets in the Lattice' and 'You Are the Apple of My Eye,' starring Ko Chen-tung, who collaborated with Ko on those two previous films. Director Giddens Ko, also active as a novelist, adapts his own internet-published novel 'Kung Fu' for the screen, weaving in homages to Hong Kong and Taiwanese wuxia films from the 1980s and 90s throughout. Underachieving high school student Yuan Zai and his best friend A Yi encounter a mysterious drifter, Huang Jun, who has awakened from a 500-year slumber. Witnessing Huang Jun's overwhelming martial arts prowess as a kung fu master, Yuan Zai and A Yi become his disciples. Their classmate Yi Jing, on whom Yuan Zai has a secret crush, also joins their training. They soon learn of the centuries-old feud between Huang Jun and his junior disciple Lan Jin, and uncover a momentous secret hidden within 'kung fu' that could shake heaven and earth. Ko Chen-tung plays Yuan Zai, Berant Zhu of 'Black Education' plays A Yi, Wang Jing of 'The Secrets in the Lattice' and 'The Return of the Condor Heroes' plays Yi Jing, veteran actor Tai Li-len plays the mysterious kung fu master Huang Jun, and Liu Kuan-ting of 'The Girl Who Robbed Time' plays Huang Jun's nemesis Lan Jin.

director: リチャード・リンクレイター
country: フランス 原題または英題：Nouvelle Vague
synopsis: 「6才のボクが、大人になるまで。」「ビフォア」シリーズのリチャード・リンクレイター監督が、1950年代後半のフランスで起きた革新的な映画運動・ヌーベルバーグを代表する作品として知られるジャン＝リュック・ゴダール監督作「勝手にしやがれ」製作の舞台裏を映画化。映画史に革命を起こした若者たちの姿を、フランス映画界を代表する映画作家たちとの活気ある交流とともに描き出す。 1959年、フランス。映画批評誌「カイエ・デュ・シネマ」で執筆活動をしていた28歳のジャン＝リュック・ゴダールは、フランスの若手俳優ジャン＝ポール・ベルモンドとアメリカの人気女優ジーン・セバーグを主演に迎えた長編監督デビュー作「勝手にしやがれ」の制作を開始する。ゴダールの斬新で自由奔放な撮影手法に周囲は振り回されるが、映画づくりへの情熱を共有した撮影現場は活気に満ちていく。 「勝手にしやがれ」のスタイルにならい、アカデミー比率（1:1.37）の白黒映像、全編ほぼフランス語で、キャストもジーン・セバーグ役のゾーイ・ドゥイッチ以外はほぼ無名の俳優陣で固めた。主人公ゴダール役には、写真家やモデルとして活動していたギョーム・マルベックを起用。2025年・第78回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門出品。
tmdb_overview_en: Composed entirely of literary quotations from many different sources and from several historical periods, the loose narrative concerns a drifter found by a rich woman who soon falls in love with him. A drowning accident takes place and the drifter dies, but some time later he reappears in the woman’s life looking for a job. Or could it be the man’s twin brother?
director_jp: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
synopsis_en: From the director of "Boyhood" and the "Before" series, Richard Linklater, comes a film that goes behind the scenes of Jean-Luc Godard's "Breathless"—a landmark work of the French New Wave, the revolutionary film movement that emerged in the late 1950s. It depicts the young people who sparked a revolution in film history, along with their vibrant interactions with the leading filmmakers of French cinema. In 1959, France. Jean-Luc Godard, a 28-year-old critic writing for the film magazine "Cahiers du Cinéma," begins production on his feature directorial debut, "Breathless," starring French up-and-coming actor Jean-Paul Belmondo and American starlet Jean Seberg. Those around him are thrown off by Godard's innovative and freewheeling shooting methods, but the set, fueled by a shared passion for filmmaking, is filled with energy. Following the style of "Breathless," the film is shot in black and white in the Academy ratio (1:1.37), almost entirely in French, and the cast, except for Zoey Deutch as Jean Seberg, is made up of mostly unknown actors. Guillaume Marbeck, who worked as a photographer and model, was cast as the protagonist Godard. The film was selected for the Competition section of the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025.

director: ホセ・ルイス・ゲリン
country: スペイン・フランス合作 原題または英題：En la ciudad de Sylvia
synopsis: 「イニスフリー」などのドキュメンタリーで注目を集めたスペインの俊英ホセ・ルイス・ゲリン監督が2007年に発表した長編劇映画。フランスの古都ストラスブールを舞台に、かつて出会った女性の面影を追い求める青年が街をさまよう姿を、緻密で独特な映像表現で描いた。 ヨーロッパの古都にあるホテルの一室で目覚めた画家志望の青年は、街のカフェで、かつてバーで会ったことのある美しい女性シルビアの姿を見つける。青年はそのシルビアと思しき女性を追いかけ、街中をさまよい歩くが……。 2007年・第64回ベネチア国際映画祭コンペティション部門に出品されたほか、2008年・第20回東京国際映画祭をはじめ各国で上映されて高い評価を獲得。「ミツバチのささやき」「エル・スール」で知られるスペインの名匠ビクトル・エリセが、ゲリンを「現代スペインで最も優れた映画作家」と称賛したことでも知られる。
tmdb_overview_en: A man returns to a city to try to track down a woman he met six years earlier.
synopsis_en: This film follows a young aspiring painter wandering through places of memory, searching for traces of Sylvia, a woman he loved six years ago. It constructs an obsessive love story reminiscent of Alfred Hitchcock's 'Vertigo' (1958) with meticulously calculated sound and imagery, resulting in a groundbreaking work unlike anything seen before. The film was shot entirely on location in Strasbourg, France, an ancient city where medieval streetscapes and cutting-edge railways coexist without dissonance, creating a stateless atmosphere. The masterful sound design, which orchestrates the city's noises—the murmur of people, the passing of trams—like a symphony, and the beautiful, luminous chain of images captured through glass reflections and tram windows, transport the viewer into an unknown, otherworldly space.

movie_title: ＜ロックの時間＞ クリーデンス・クリアウォーター・リヴァイヴァル　トラヴェリン・バンド
movie_title_en: Travelin' Band: Creedence Clearwater Revival at the Royal Albert Hall
tmdb_overview_en: Featuring never-before-seen concert footage and narration by Jeff Bridges, this documentary explores CCR's humble origins and meteoric rise. It includes the entire set recorded at the Royal Albert Hall on April 14th, 1970.
clean_title_jp: Travelin' Band: Creedence Clearwater Revival at the Royal Albert Hall
movie_title_jp: Travelin' Band: Creedence Clearwater Revival at the Royal Albert Hall
movie_title_original: Travelin' Band: Creedence Clearwater Revival at the Royal Albert Hall
synopsis_en: A film documenting and screening the legendary 1970 London performance of the American rock band Creedence Clearwater Revival (CCR). In 1970, at the height of their popularity, CCR embarked on their first and only European tour. The highlight of the tour was their performance at the Royal Albert Hall in London on April 14, where CCR aimed to challenge The Beatles, whose record sales were the highest in the world at the time, by performing in their home territory. However, four days before the performance, news of The Beatles' breakup was reported. Despite this, CCR delivered a powerful, all-or-nothing performance, making the Royal Albert Hall concert one of the greatest live shows in rock history. The complete footage of the London performance, discovered after 50 years, has been restored in 4K, and the film traces their trajectory, interweaving footage capturing the band's daily life, interviews with members, and early live performances. Directed by Bob Smeaton of 'The Beatles Anthology,' with narration by actor Jeff Bridges.

movie_title: ＜ロックの時間＞ ザ・フー　キッズ・アー・オールライト
movie_title_en: The Who: The Kids Are Alright
tmdb_overview_jp: ザ・ビートルズ、ザ・ローリング・ストーンズと共にブリティッシュ・ロックの黄金期を牽引し、ロックを革新し続けたスーパーバンド、ザ・フー。それにもかかわらず全盛期の来日がかなわなかった彼らの1964年から1978年までの代表曲のライブパフォーマンスを中心に、プロモーションフィルム、インタビューなどを含む、ロック・ドキュメンタリー映画史上の傑作。数多い歴史的なシーンの中でもとりわけ、本作のために1978年5月にシェバートン・スタジオで撮影された、伝説的天才ドラマー、キース・ムーン最後の渾身のパフォーマンスがフィーチャーされているのは貴重。
tmdb_overview_en: Through concert performances and interviews, this film offers us a comprehensive look at the British pioneer rock group, The Who. It captures their zany craziness and outrageous antics from the initial formation of the group in 1964 to 1978. It notably features the band's last performance with long-term drummer Keith Moon, filmed at Shepperton Studios in May 1978, three months before his death.
clean_title_jp: ザ・フー キッズ・アー・オールライト
movie_title_jp: ザ・フー キッズ・アー・オールライト
movie_title_original: The Who: The Kids Are Alright
synopsis_en: Alongside The Beatles and The Rolling Stones, The Who led the golden age of British rock and continued to innovate the genre as a superband. This rock documentary masterpiece features live performances of their greatest hits from 1964 to 1978—a period when they were unable to tour Japan at their peak—along with promotional films and interviews. Among the many historic scenes, the film notably features Keith Moon, the legendary genius drummer, in his final full-bodied performance, filmed at Shepperton Studios in May 1978 specifically for this production—a truly precious treasure.

tmdb_overview_jp: 映画女優になる夢を抱くモ。しかし、万年エキストラのまま、回ってくる仕事は顔すら映らない端役や死体の役ばかり。ある日、役作りのプチ整形顔がスタッフの目に止まり、かつてのスター俳優マー主演の超大作「白雪姫 血のチャイナタウン」に抜擢された。だがマーは演技も性格も最低最悪。過去の栄光にすがるトラブルメーカーだった。落ちぶれ俳優マーと、底辺から脱しようと奮闘するモン。やがてこの出会いが、2人の人生を大きく変えていく──!!
tmdb_overview_en: A young female actor dreams of becoming famous and building a successful career despite being a stand-in and extra on most sets.
synopsis_en: Mo dreams of becoming a movie actress. But she remains a perpetual extra, and the only roles that come her way are bit parts where her face never even appears, or corpse roles. One day, her minor cosmetic surgery for a role catches the eye of a staff member, and she is selected for the blockbuster "Snow White: Bloody Chinatown," starring former star actor Ma. But Ma is the absolute worst in both acting and personality—a troublemaker clinging to past glory. A washed-up actor Ma, and Mon, fighting to climb out from the bottom. Before long, this encounter will drastically change both of their lives—!!

movie_title: ＜エッセンシャル・ヌーヴェルヴァーグ＞ 女と男のいる舗道　4K修復版
director: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
tmdb_overview_jp: 「勝手にしやがれ」のジャン＝リュック・ゴダールの長編第4作で、前作「女は女である」に続き、公私にわたるパートナーのアンナ・カリーナ主演で撮りあげた作品。パリのとあるカフェで、夫と人生を語り合った末に別れることになったナナ。家賃も払えないほどの生活に陥ってしまった彼女は、街で男を誘い売春するように。やがてナナは、見知らぬ男と関係を持つことに無感覚になっていく。「シェルブールの雨傘」などの名作曲家ミシェル・ルグランが音楽を手がけた。
tmdb_overview_en: Twelve episodic tales in the life of a Parisian woman and her slow descent into prostitution.
movie_title_original: Vivre sa vie: film en douze tableaux
director_jp: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
synopsis_en: This is Jean-Luc Godard's fourth feature film, following "A Woman Is a Woman," and was shot starring Anna Karina, his partner both publicly and privately. Nana, who decides to part ways with her husband after discussing life with him at a café in Paris, falls into a life where she cannot even pay her rent. She begins to proposition men on the street and engage in prostitution. Eventually, Nana becomes numb to having relations with strangers. The music was handled by Michel Legrand, the renowned composer of "The Umbrellas of Cherbourg" and other films.

tmdb_overview_jp: 妻を病気で亡くしたティーは工事現場で働きながら一人息子のディッキーを一流私立小学校に通わせている。ディッキーの欲しがる運動靴を拾いに行ったゴミ捨て場で、ティーは緑色のボールを見つける。ティーが持ち帰ったボールから生まれた生物（かどうか不明な物体）をディッキーはミラクル7号と呼んで飼い始める。
tmdb_overview_en: A poor construction worker, who struggles to keep his son in private school, mistakes an orb he finds in a junkjard for a toy which proves to be much, much more once the young boy starts to play with it.
genres: サイエンスフィクション
synopsis_en: Ti, who lost his wife to illness, works at a construction site to send his only son Dicky to a prestigious private elementary school. While retrieving a pair of sneakers Dicky wanted from the garbage dump, Ti finds a green ball. Dicky begins keeping the creature (or is it an object of unknown nature?) that is born from the ball Ti brought home, naming it Miracle 7.

movie_title: ＜エッセンシャル・ヌーヴェルヴァーグ＞ 女は女である　4K修復版
director: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
tmdb_overview_jp: 「勝手にしやがれ」のジャン＝リュック・ゴダールの長編第3作で、“登場人物が歌わないミュージカルコメディ”という発想に基づいて制作されたラブコメディ。キャバレーの踊り子アンジェラは一緒に暮らす恋人エミールに、今すぐに子どもが欲しいと言い出す。エミールはそんな彼女に戸惑いを隠せない。そこへ、アンジェラに想いを寄せる青年アルフレッドが現れ……。ゴダール監督の前作「小さな兵隊」に続いてアンナ・カリーナがヒロインを務め、「勝手にしやがれ」のジャン＝ポール・ベルモンドがアルフレッド、「いとこ同志」のジャン＝クロード・ブリアリがエミールを演じた。「シェルブールの雨傘」などの名作曲家ミシェル・ルグランが音楽を担当。
tmdb_overview_en: Longing for a baby, a stripper pursues another man in order to make her boyfriend jealous.
director_jp: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
synopsis_en: This is Jean-Luc Godard's third feature film, following "Breathless," and a romantic comedy created based on the idea of a "musical comedy in which the characters do not sing." Angela, a cabaret dancer, tells her live-in lover Émile that she wants a child right now. Émile cannot hide his bewilderment at her request. Then a young man named Alfred, who has feelings for Angela, appears... Following Godard's previous film "Le Petit Soldat," Anna Karina plays the heroine, with Jean-Paul Belmondo of "Breathless" as Alfred and Jean-Claude Brialy of "Les Cousins" as Émile. The music is by Michel Legrand, the renowned composer of "The Umbrellas of Cherbourg" and other films.

tmdb_overview_jp: 1930年代の上海は、新興の暴力組織、斧頭会が牛耳っていた。猪籠城寨（豚小屋砦）と呼ばれる貧困者アパートにチンピラのシンとその相棒が斧頭会を名乗り恐喝に来た。住人を舐めていたが逆にボコボコにされ、苦し紛れに投げた爆竹で偶然通りかかった斧頭会幹部に怪我をさせてしまう。
tmdb_overview_en: It's the 1940s, and the notorious Axe Gang terrorizes Shanghai. Small-time criminals Sing and Bone hope to join, but they only manage to make lots of very dangerous enemies. Fortunately for them, kung fu masters and hidden strength can be found in unlikely places. Now they just have to take on the entire Axe Gang.
synopsis_en: A wuxia fantasy action film directed by Taiwanese director Giddens Ko of 'The Secrets in the Lattice' and 'You Are the Apple of My Eye,' starring Ko Chen-tung, who collaborated with Ko on those two previous films. Director Giddens Ko, also active as a novelist, adapts his own internet-published novel 'Kung Fu' for the screen, weaving in homages to Hong Kong and Taiwanese wuxia films from the 1980s and 90s throughout. Underachieving high school student Yuan Zai and his best friend A Yi encounter a mysterious drifter, Huang Jun, who has awakened from a 500-year slumber. Witnessing Huang Jun's overwhelming martial arts prowess as a kung fu master, Yuan Zai and A Yi become his disciples. Their classmate Yi Jing, on whom Yuan Zai has a secret crush, also joins their training. They soon learn of the centuries-old feud between Huang Jun and his junior disciple Lan Jin, and uncover a momentous secret hidden within 'kung fu' that could shake heaven and earth. Ko Chen-tung plays Yuan Zai, Berant Zhu of 'Black Education' plays A Yi, Wang Jing of 'The Secrets in the Lattice' and 'The Return of the Condor Heroes' plays Yi Jing, veteran actor Tai Li-len plays the mysterious kung fu master Huang Jun, and Liu Kuan-ting of 'The Girl Who Robbed Time' plays Huang Jun's nemesis Lan Jin.

synopsis: かいせつ 旧華族の一人娘の雪は、婿養子の夫の放蕩と横暴に苦しめられ…。戦前から在籍した松竹を離れた溝口が新東宝で撮った官能のメロドラマ。雪夫人を演じた木暮の目も眩む濃密なエロスが、溝口独特の耽美的な世界へと誘い込む。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: A young woman takes up her new job as the servant of a noblewoman and soon discovers that underneath her facade of luxury lies great unhappiness.
synopsis_en: A commentary: Yuki, the only daughter of an old aristocratic family, is tormented by the debauchery and tyranny of her husband, who married into the family... This sensual melodrama was shot by Mizoguchi at Shin Toho after he left Shochiku, where he had worked since before the war. The dazzling, dense eroticism of Kogure, who plays Lady Yuki, lures the viewer into Mizoguchi's uniquely decadent world.

synopsis: かいせつ 貴族に代わり武士が台頭した平安末期、平清盛は様々な苦難に直面し…。出生の秘密に悩む“人間”清盛を、溝口が圧倒的なスケールで描く歴史劇。デビュー間もない雷蔵が若き清盛を颯爽と演じ、濃艶な母親役の木暮も忘れ難い。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 日本、1137年。鳥羽天皇と比叡山の僧との争いに巻き込まれた武士、平氏。
tmdb_overview_en: Japan, 1137. The Taira family, a samurai clan, becomes involved in the disputes between Emperor Toba and the monks of Mount Hiei.
synopsis_en: A commentary: In the late Heian period, when warriors rose in place of the aristocracy, Taira no Kiyomori faces various hardships... Mizoguchi depicts the "human" Kiyomori, tormented by the secret of his birth, on an overwhelming scale in this historical drama. A young Raizō, early in his debut, plays the youthful Kiyomori with dashing flair, and the unforgettable performance by Kogure as his sensuous mother lingers in the mind.

synopsis: かいせつ 妹の縁談相手の男は、見合いに同席した姉に惹かれ…。数々の傑作を生み出し黄金期となる大映での溝口の第一作。名キャメラマン・宮川とも初めて組み、美しい姉妹と一人の男の揺れ動く三角関係を繊細で夢幻的な映像美で描く。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: Shinnosuke is introduced to Shizu as a prospective marriage partner, but he falls in love with her widowed sister Oyu. Convention forbids Oyu to marry because she has to raise her son as the head of her husband's family. Oyu convinces Shinnosuke and Shizu to marry so that she can remain close to Shinnosuke.
synopsis_en: A commentary: The man who is a match for the younger sister becomes drawn to the older sister who sits in on the arranged meeting... This is Mizoguchi's first film at Daiei, which produced numerous masterpieces during its golden age. Collaborating for the first time with the renowned cinematographer Miyagawa, it delicately depicts the shifting love triangle between two beautiful sisters and one man with a dreamlike visual beauty.

synopsis: かいせつ 最愛の妃を亡くした唐の玄宗皇帝が、一人の娘を見初めて…。香港との共同制作となった溝口初のカラー作品は、傾国の美女・楊貴妃の愛と悲運を描いた宮廷絵巻。エキゾチックな衣装と美術を際立たせる抑えた色調が目をひく。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: In 8th-century China, the Emperor grieves the death of his wife. The Yang family wants to provide the Emperor with a consort so that they may consolidate their court influence. General An Lushan finds a distant relative working in their kitchen, whom they groom to present to the Emperor. The Emperor falls in love and she becomes the Princess Yang Kwei-fei. The Yangs are then appointed important ministers, though An Lushan is not given the court position he covets.
synopsis_en: A commentary: Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, grieving the loss of his beloved consort, sets his sights on a young woman... Mizoguchi's first color film, a co-production with Hong Kong, is a courtly tapestry portraying the love and tragic fate of Yang Guifei, the beauty who toppled an empire. The restrained color palette that highlights the exotic costumes and art direction is striking.

synopsis_en: Mo dreams of becoming a movie actress. But she remains a perpetual extra, and the only roles that come her way are bit parts where her face never even appears, or corpse roles. But Ma is the absolute worst in both acting and personality—a troublemaker clinging to past glory. A washed-up actor Ma, and Mon, fighting to climb out from the bottom. Before long, this encounter will drastically change both of their lives—!!

Director No Yeong-seon, based in France, turns her gaze on three generations of women in her family—her mother living on Ganghwa Island, South Korea, and her grandmother who died in Okinawa during the war—who lived knowing little of each other. Through the universal question, 'Can we mourn those we have no memory of?' she depicts the transmission of war memories in this documentary. Director No, living in France, has a mother who lives on Ganghwa Island where she was born and raised. Her grandmother, during the end of World War II under Japanese colonial rule, followed her Korean lover from Japan to Seoul. The mother and grandmother were separated during the chaos of the Korean War, so the mother has no memory of the grandmother. Director No tentatively calls this grandmother 'Yukiko' and, using the two islands—Ganghwa Island where her mother lives and Okinawa, which Yukiko chose as her final resting place—as settings, intimately portrays the three generations of women while quietly examining the transmission of war memories through the question, 'Can we mourn those we have no memory of?' The film was screened in the International Competition section of the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival in 2019, one of Asia's largest documentary film festivals. It will be shown in August 2026 at Cinema Rise in Jimbocho, Tokyo, as part of the 'Yama-Doc Teiki-bin' program, which screens films related to the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival.

Director Giddens Ko, also active as a novelist, adapts his own internet-published novel 'Kung Fu' for the screen, weaving in homages to Hong Kong and Taiwanese wuxia films from the 1980s and 90s throughout. Underachieving high school student Yuan Zai and his best friend A Yi encounter a mysterious drifter, Huang Jun, who has awakened from a 500-year slumber. Witnessing Huang Jun's overwhelming martial arts prowess as a kung fu master, Yuan Zai and A Yi become his disciples. Their classmate Yi Jing, on whom Yuan Zai has a secret crush, also joins their training. They soon learn of the centuries-old feud between Huang Jun and his junior disciple Lan Jin, and uncover a momentous secret hidden within 'kung fu' that could shake heaven and earth. Ko Chen-tung plays Yuan Zai, Berant Zhu of 'Black Education' plays A Yi, Wang Jing of 'The Secrets in the Lattice' and 'The Return of the Condor Heroes' plays Yi Jing, veteran actor Tai Li-len plays the mysterious kung fu master Huang Jun, and Liu Kuan-ting of 'The Girl Who Robbed Time' plays Huang Jun's nemesis Lan Jin.

movie_title: シンプル・アクシデント／偶然
tmdb_overview_jp: かつて不当な理由で投獄されたワヒドは、ある偶然によって、自分の人生を奪った看守に出会う。咄嗟に男を拘束し、荒野に穴を掘り埋めようとするが、男は人違いだと言う。実はワヒドは、男の顔を見たことがなかった。男は、本当に復讐の相手なのか？一旦復讐を中断し、同じ男に拷問された友人を訪ねることにするが･･･。
tmdb_overview_en: An unassuming mechanic is reminded of his time in an Iranian prison when he encounters a man he suspects to be his sadistic jailhouse captor.
clean_title_jp: シンプル・アクシデント／偶然
movie_title_jp: シンプル・アクシデント／偶然
synopsis_en: A suspense thriller by Iranian master Jafar Panahi, winner of the Palme d'Or at the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025. It thrillingly and humorously depicts people wrongfully imprisoned seeking revenge. Vahid, once unjustly imprisoned, accidentally encounters a man he believes was his torturer guard. He forcibly restrains the man and digs a hole in the wilderness to bury him, but the man's ID card shows a different name. The man claims it's a case of mistaken identity. Blindfolded during imprisonment, Vahid never saw his torturer's face. Unsure if this is the right man, Vahid pauses revenge and visits a friend who was also tortured by the same guard. Panahi, banned from filmmaking by the Iranian government for opposition activities, drew inspiration from his own two imprisonments and the real voices of cellmates. Having won the Golden Lion at Venice for 'The Circle' and 'No Bears', and the Golden Bear at Berlin for 'Taxi', Panahi achieved the feat of winning top prizes at all three major festivals with this film. A French co-production, it was France's entry for Best International Feature Film at the 98th Academy Awards and received a nomination.

director: ホセ・ルイス・ゲリン
country: スペイン・フランス合作 原題または英題：Historias del buen valle
synopsis: 「シルビアのいる街で」などで知られるスペインの名匠ホセ・ルイス・ゲリンの10年ぶりとなる長編監督作で、バルセロナ郊外の集落・バルボナ地区を舞台に、変わりゆく時代と人々の生活を見つめたドキュメンタリー。 スペインのバルセロナ郊外に位置するバルボナ地区。「よき谷」と名付けられたこの地は川や線路に囲まれ、開発から取り残された陸の孤島であり、大都市の近くとは思えないほど豊かな自然に恵まれている。ここには20世紀半ばに移り住んできた人々と、最近になってやってきた新世代の移民たちが共に暮らしている。インド、ジャマイカ、ロシア、ウクライナなど世界中から集まってきた彼らは文化も生活スタイルも異なるが、子どもたちは一緒に川で遊び、誰もがよく食べて飲んで歌い、踊り、ひとときの安らぎを得る。そんな都会のオアシスのような地に鉄道増設の計画が持ち上がり、一部の人々は立ち退きを迫られてしまう。 ゲリン監督が3年の歳月をかけてバルボナ地区にカメラを向け、愛情を込めながら住民たちの生活を記録。ひとつの小さな地区を舞台に、そこに生き続ける市井の人々と、流れ続ける人類の営みを詩情ゆたかに映し出す。2025年・第73回サン・セバスティアン国際映画祭で審査員特別賞を受賞。
tmdb_overview_jp: スペイン、バルセロナ郊外に位置するバルボナ地区。“よき⾕”と名付けられたこの場所は川や線路に囲まれ、開発から取り残された陸の孤島でありながら、⼤都市の近くとは思えないほどの豊かな⾃然に恵まれた理想郷のようでもある。ここには 20 世紀半ばから移り住んだ住⺠の家族と、最近になってやってきた新世代の移⺠たちが共に暮らしている。⽂化や⽣活スタイルは異なるものの、⼦供たちはともに川で遊び、誰もがよく⾷べて飲んで、歌い、踊り、ひとときの安らぎを得る。そんな都会のオアシスに、新しく鉄道増設の計画が持ち上がった。住⺠説明会が開かれ、⼀部の⼈々は⽴ち退きを迫られるが……。
tmdb_overview_en: In a peripheral neighbourhood, where the rural and urban worlds meet, the houses of the first migrants who arrived after the post-war period coexist with the new blocks of the dormitory city, where the latest wave of migration is concentrated. This humble corner is now an authentic global village. Good Valley Stories is a sum of constructs, of social, generational and identity, urban and ecological conflicts, but it is also a calm and humanistic look at today’s world.
synopsis_en: A new feature film from director José Luis Guerín, who captivated the world with 'In the City of Sylvia' (2007) and was called 'the most outstanding filmmaker in contemporary Spain' by fellow Spanish director Víctor Erice. Despite his sparse output, Guerín continues to create masterpieces that lightly transcend the boundaries between fiction and documentary. This is his long-awaited new film, his first in ten years since 'The Academy of Muses' (2015), now arriving in Japan. To commemorate the release of 'The Good Valley Story,' the beautiful masterpiece 'In the City of Sylvia' will also be revived. Please enjoy Guerín's world on the big screen. The Vallbona district, located on the outskirts of Barcelona, Spain. This place, named 'The Good Valley,' is surrounded by rivers and railway tracks, an isolated land left behind by development, yet it also seems like an ideal paradise blessed with nature so rich it's hard to believe it's near a big city. Here, families who moved in from the mid-20th century live together with a new generation of immigrants who have arrived recently. Although their cultures and lifestyles differ, the children play together in the river, and everyone eats, drinks, sings, and dances well, finding a moment of peace. A new railway expansion plan is proposed for this urban oasis. A residents' information meeting is held, and some people are forced to relocate...

synopsis_en: Mo dreams of becoming a movie actress. But she remains a perpetual extra, and the only roles that come her way are bit parts where her face never even appears, or corpse roles. One day, her minor cosmetic surgery for a role catches the eye of a staff member, and she is selected for the blockbuster "Snow White: Bloody Chinatown," starring former star actor Ma. But Ma is the absolute worst in both acting and personality—a troublemaker clinging to past glory. A washed-up actor Ma, and Mon, fighting to climb out from the bottom. Before long, this encounter will drastically change both of their lives—!!

movie_title: ＜エッセンシャル・ヌーヴェルヴァーグ＞ はなればなれに　2K修復版
director: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
tmdb_overview_en: Cinephile slackers Franz and Arthur spend their days mimicking the antiheroes of Hollywood noirs and Westerns while pursuing the lovely Odile. The misfit trio upends convention at every turn, be it through choreographed dances in cafés or frolicsome romps through the Louvre. Eventually, their romantic view of outlaws pushes them to plan their own heist, but their inexperience may send them out in a blaze of glory -- which could be just what they want.
director_jp: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
synopsis_en: A masterpiece from Jean-Luc Godard's early period, this melodrama is based on an American crime novel and depicts in comedic fashion the love triangle and criminal scheme involving two men and one woman. Winter in Paris. Franz and Arthur, best friends with completely opposite personalities, both fall in love at first sight with Odile, a beautiful and shy woman from Scandinavia. One day, they learn that a large sum of money is hidden in Odile's aunt's house, and the three plot to steal it, but the plan takes unexpected twists and turns... This was the first production from "Anouchka Films," the production company founded by Godard and actress Anna Karina, who played Odile and were married at the time. Music by Michel Legrand of "The Umbrellas of Cherbourg." It went unreleased in Japanese theaters for many years before finally premiering in 2001.

tmdb_overview_jp: 妻を病気で亡くしたティーは工事現場で働きながら一人息子のディッキーを一流私立小学校に通わせている。ディッキーの欲しがる運動靴を拾いに行ったゴミ捨て場で、ティーは緑色のボールを見つける。ティーが持ち帰ったボールから生まれた生物（かどうか不明な物体）をディッキーはミラクル7号と呼んで飼い始める。
tmdb_overview_en: A poor construction worker, who struggles to keep his son in private school, mistakes an orb he finds in a junkjard for a toy which proves to be much, much more once the young boy starts to play with it.
genres: サイエンスフィクション
synopsis_en: Ti, who lost his wife to illness, works at a construction site to send his only son Dicky to a prestigious private elementary school. While retrieving a pair of sneakers Dicky wanted from the garbage dump, Ti finds a green ball. Dicky begins keeping the creature (or is it an object of unknown nature?) that is born from the ball Ti brought home, naming it Miracle 7.

country: フランス 原題または英題：Nouvelle Vague
synopsis: 「6才のボクが、大人になるまで。」「ビフォア」シリーズのリチャード・リンクレイター監督が、1950年代後半のフランスで起きた革新的な映画運動・ヌーベルバーグを代表する作品として知られるジャン＝リュック・ゴダール監督作「勝手にしやがれ」製作の舞台裏を映画化。映画史に革命を起こした若者たちの姿を、フランス映画界を代表する映画作家たちとの活気ある交流とともに描き出す。 1959年、フランス。映画批評誌「カイエ・デュ・シネマ」で執筆活動をしていた28歳のジャン＝リュック・ゴダールは、フランスの若手俳優ジャン＝ポール・ベルモンドとアメリカの人気女優ジーン・セバーグを主演に迎えた長編監督デビュー作「勝手にしやがれ」の制作を開始する。ゴダールの斬新で自由奔放な撮影手法に周囲は振り回されるが、映画づくりへの情熱を共有した撮影現場は活気に満ちていく。 「勝手にしやがれ」のスタイルにならい、アカデミー比率（1:1.37）の白黒映像、全編ほぼフランス語で、キャストもジーン・セバーグ役のゾーイ・ドゥイッチ以外はほぼ無名の俳優陣で固めた。主人公ゴダール役には、写真家やモデルとして活動していたギョーム・マルベックを起用。2025年・第78回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門出品。
tmdb_overview_en: Composed entirely of literary quotations from many different sources and from several historical periods, the loose narrative concerns a drifter found by a rich woman who soon falls in love with him. A drowning accident takes place and the drifter dies, but some time later he reappears in the woman’s life looking for a job. Or could it be the man’s twin brother?
director_jp: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
synopsis_en: From the director of "Boyhood" and the "Before" series, Richard Linklater, comes a film that goes behind the scenes of Jean-Luc Godard's "Breathless"—a landmark work of the French New Wave, the revolutionary film movement that emerged in the late 1950s. It depicts the young people who sparked a revolution in film history, along with their vibrant interactions with the leading filmmakers of French cinema. In 1959, France. Jean-Luc Godard, a 28-year-old critic writing for the film magazine "Cahiers du Cinéma," begins production on his feature directorial debut, "Breathless," starring French up-and-coming actor Jean-Paul Belmondo and American starlet Jean Seberg. Those around him are thrown off by Godard's innovative and freewheeling shooting methods, but the set, fueled by a shared passion for filmmaking, is filled with energy. Following the style of "Breathless," the film is shot in black and white in the Academy ratio (1:1.37), almost entirely in French, and the cast, except for Zoey Deutch as Jean Seberg, is made up of mostly unknown actors. Guillaume Marbeck, who worked as a photographer and model, was cast as the protagonist Godard. The film was selected for the Competition section of the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025.

tmdb_overview_jp: 1930年代の上海は、新興の暴力組織、斧頭会が牛耳っていた。猪籠城寨（豚小屋砦）と呼ばれる貧困者アパートにチンピラのシンとその相棒が斧頭会を名乗り恐喝に来た。住人を舐めていたが逆にボコボコにされ、苦し紛れに投げた爆竹で偶然通りかかった斧頭会幹部に怪我をさせてしまう。
tmdb_overview_en: It's the 1940s, and the notorious Axe Gang terrorizes Shanghai. Small-time criminals Sing and Bone hope to join, but they only manage to make lots of very dangerous enemies. Fortunately for them, kung fu masters and hidden strength can be found in unlikely places. Now they just have to take on the entire Axe Gang.

movie_title: ＜エッセンシャル・ヌーヴェルヴァーグ （特別上映）＞ パリところどころ　2K修復版
tmdb_overview_en: Six vignettes set in different sections of Paris, by six directors. St. Germain des Pres (Douchet), Gare du Nord (Rouch), Rue St. Denis (Pollet), and Montparnasse et Levallois (Godard) are stories of love, flirtation and prostitution; Place d'Etoile (Rohmer) concerns a haberdasher and his umbrella; and La Muette (Chabrol), a bourgeois family and earplugs.
synopsis_en: An omnibus film of short works, each directed by one of six leading directors of the French New Wave, all set against the backdrop of Paris. The six episodes are: "Saint-Denis Street" (directed by Jean-Daniel Pollet), about a timid man who brings a prostitute he met in a red-light district back to his apartment; "North Station" (Jean Rouch), about a woman living with her lover in an apartment far from the station who encounters an unexpected incident on her way to work after arguing with him; "Saint-Germain-des-Prés" (Jean Douchet), depicting the romantic entanglements of young people in a student quarter; "Place de l'Étoile" (Éric Rohmer), about a man heading to work through the Place de l'Étoile who faces a series of troubles; "Montparnasse and Levallois" (Jean-Luc Godard), about a woman who writes love letters to two different men but accidentally mails the wrong ones; and "La Muette" (Claude Chabrol), depicting a tragedy that strikes a bourgeois family in an upscale neighborhood from the son's perspective. The cast includes Joanna Shimkus from "The Adventurers," Stéphane Audran from "Babette's Feast," and Barbet Schroeder, who also produced this film, among others.

synopsis: かいせつ 貴族に代わり武士が台頭した平安末期、平清盛は様々な苦難に直面し…。出生の秘密に悩む“人間”清盛を、溝口が圧倒的なスケールで描く歴史劇。デビュー間もない雷蔵が若き清盛を颯爽と演じ、濃艶な母親役の木暮も忘れ難い。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 日本、1137年。鳥羽天皇と比叡山の僧との争いに巻き込まれた武士、平氏。
tmdb_overview_en: Japan, 1137. The Taira family, a samurai clan, becomes involved in the disputes between Emperor Toba and the monks of Mount Hiei.
synopsis_en: A commentary: In the late Heian period, when warriors rose in place of the aristocracy, Taira no Kiyomori faces various hardships... Mizoguchi depicts the "human" Kiyomori, tormented by the secret of his birth, on an overwhelming scale in this historical drama. A young Raizō, early in his debut, plays the youthful Kiyomori with dashing flair, and the unforgettable performance by Kogure as his sensuous mother lingers in the mind.

synopsis: かいせつ 最愛の妃を亡くした唐の玄宗皇帝が、一人の娘を見初めて…。香港との共同制作となった溝口初のカラー作品は、傾国の美女・楊貴妃の愛と悲運を描いた宮廷絵巻。エキゾチックな衣装と美術を際立たせる抑えた色調が目をひく。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: In 8th-century China, the Emperor grieves the death of his wife. The Yang family wants to provide the Emperor with a consort so that they may consolidate their court influence. General An Lushan finds a distant relative working in their kitchen, whom they groom to present to the Emperor. The Emperor falls in love and she becomes the Princess Yang Kwei-fei. The Yangs are then appointed important ministers, though An Lushan is not given the court position he covets.
synopsis_en: A commentary: Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, grieving the loss of his beloved consort, sets his sights on a young woman... Mizoguchi's first color film, a co-production with Hong Kong, is a courtly tapestry portraying the love and tragic fate of Yang Guifei, the beauty who toppled an empire. The restrained color palette that highlights the exotic costumes and art direction is striking.

synopsis: かいせつ 旧華族の一人娘の雪は、婿養子の夫の放蕩と横暴に苦しめられ…。戦前から在籍した松竹を離れた溝口が新東宝で撮った官能のメロドラマ。雪夫人を演じた木暮の目も眩む濃密なエロスが、溝口独特の耽美的な世界へと誘い込む。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: A young woman takes up her new job as the servant of a noblewoman and soon discovers that underneath her facade of luxury lies great unhappiness.
synopsis_en: A commentary: Yuki, the only daughter of an old aristocratic family, is tormented by the debauchery and tyranny of her husband, who married into the family... This sensual melodrama was shot by Mizoguchi at Shin Toho after he left Shochiku, where he had worked since before the war. The dazzling, dense eroticism of Kogure, who plays Lady Yuki, lures the viewer into Mizoguchi's uniquely decadent world.

synopsis: かいせつ 妹の縁談相手の男は、見合いに同席した姉に惹かれ…。数々の傑作を生み出し黄金期となる大映での溝口の第一作。名キャメラマン・宮川とも初めて組み、美しい姉妹と一人の男の揺れ動く三角関係を繊細で夢幻的な映像美で描く。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_en: Shinnosuke is introduced to Shizu as a prospective marriage partner, but he falls in love with her widowed sister Oyu. Convention forbids Oyu to marry because she has to raise her son as the head of her husband's family. Oyu convinces Shinnosuke and Shizu to marry so that she can remain close to Shinnosuke.
synopsis_en: A commentary: The man who is a match for the younger sister becomes drawn to the older sister who sits in on the arranged meeting... This is Mizoguchi's first film at Daiei, which produced numerous masterpieces during its golden age. Collaborating for the first time with the renowned cinematographer Miyagawa, it delicately depicts the shifting love triangle between two beautiful sisters and one man with a dreamlike visual beauty.

He forcibly restrains the man and digs a hole in the wilderness to bury him, but the man's ID card shows a different name. The man claims it's a case of mistaken identity. Blindfolded during imprisonment, Vahid never saw his torturer's face. Unsure if this is the right man, Vahid pauses revenge and visits a friend who was also tortured by the same guard. Panahi, banned from filmmaking by the Iranian government for opposition activities, drew inspiration from his own two imprisonments and the real voices of cellmates. Having won the Golden Lion at Venice for 'The Circle' and 'No Bears', and the Golden Bear at Berlin for 'Taxi', Panahi achieved the feat of winning top prizes at all three major festivals with this film. A French co-production, it was France's entry for Best International Feature Film at the 98th Academy Awards and received a nomination.

genres: サイエンスフィクション
synopsis_en: Ti, who lost his wife to illness, works at a construction site to send his only son Dicky to a prestigious private elementary school. While retrieving a pair of sneakers Dicky wanted from the garbage dump, Ti finds a green ball. Dicky begins keeping the creature (or is it an object of unknown nature?) that is born from the ball Ti brought home, naming it Miracle 7.

Director No Yeong-seon, based in France, turns her gaze on three generations of women in her family—her mother living on Ganghwa Island, South Korea, and her grandmother who died in Okinawa during the war—who lived knowing little of each other. Through the universal question, 'Can we mourn those we have no memory of?' she depicts the transmission of war memories in this documentary. Director No, living in France, has a mother who lives on Ganghwa Island where she was born and raised. Her grandmother, during the end of World War II under Japanese colonial rule, followed her Korean lover from Japan to Seoul. The mother and grandmother were separated during the chaos of the Korean War, so the mother has no memory of the grandmother. Director No tentatively calls this grandmother 'Yukiko' and, using the two islands—Ganghwa Island where her mother lives and Okinawa, which Yukiko chose as her final resting place—as settings, intimately portrays the three generations of women while quietly examining the transmission of war memories through the question, 'Can we mourn those we have no memory of?' The film was screened in the International Competition section of the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival in 2019, one of Asia's largest documentary film festivals. It will be shown in August 2026 at Cinema Rise in Jimbocho, Tokyo, as part of the 'Yama-Doc Teiki-bin' program, which screens films related to the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival.

director: リチャード・リンクレイター
country: フランス 原題または英題：Nouvelle Vague
synopsis: 「6才のボクが、大人になるまで。」「ビフォア」シリーズのリチャード・リンクレイター監督が、1950年代後半のフランスで起きた革新的な映画運動・ヌーベルバーグを代表する作品として知られるジャン＝リュック・ゴダール監督作「勝手にしやがれ」製作の舞台裏を映画化。映画史に革命を起こした若者たちの姿を、フランス映画界を代表する映画作家たちとの活気ある交流とともに描き出す。 1959年、フランス。映画批評誌「カイエ・デュ・シネマ」で執筆活動をしていた28歳のジャン＝リュック・ゴダールは、フランスの若手俳優ジャン＝ポール・ベルモンドとアメリカの人気女優ジーン・セバーグを主演に迎えた長編監督デビュー作「勝手にしやがれ」の制作を開始する。ゴダールの斬新で自由奔放な撮影手法に周囲は振り回されるが、映画づくりへの情熱を共有した撮影現場は活気に満ちていく。 「勝手にしやがれ」のスタイルにならい、アカデミー比率（1:1.37）の白黒映像、全編ほぼフランス語で、キャストもジーン・セバーグ役のゾーイ・ドゥイッチ以外はほぼ無名の俳優陣で固めた。主人公ゴダール役には、写真家やモデルとして活動していたギョーム・マルベックを起用。2025年・第78回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門出品。
tmdb_overview_en: Composed entirely of literary quotations from many different sources and from several historical periods, the loose narrative concerns a drifter found by a rich woman who soon falls in love with him. A drowning accident takes place and the drifter dies, but some time later he reappears in the woman’s life looking for a job. Or could it be the man’s twin brother?
director_jp: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
synopsis_en: From the director of "Boyhood" and the "Before" series, Richard Linklater, comes a film that goes behind the scenes of Jean-Luc Godard's "Breathless"—a landmark work of the French New Wave, the revolutionary film movement that emerged in the late 1950s. It depicts the young people who sparked a revolution in film history, along with their vibrant interactions with the leading filmmakers of French cinema. In 1959, France. Jean-Luc Godard, a 28-year-old critic writing for the film magazine "Cahiers du Cinéma," begins production on his feature directorial debut, "Breathless," starring French up-and-coming actor Jean-Paul Belmondo and American starlet Jean Seberg. Those around him are thrown off by Godard's innovative and freewheeling shooting methods, but the set, fueled by a shared passion for filmmaking, is filled with energy. Following the style of "Breathless," the film is shot in black and white in the Academy ratio (1:1.37), almost entirely in French, and the cast, except for Zoey Deutch as Jean Seberg, is made up of mostly unknown actors. Guillaume Marbeck, who worked as a photographer and model, was cast as the protagonist Godard. The film was selected for the Competition section of the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025.

director: ホセ・ルイス・ゲリン
country: スペイン・フランス合作 原題または英題：En la ciudad de Sylvia
synopsis: 「イニスフリー」などのドキュメンタリーで注目を集めたスペインの俊英ホセ・ルイス・ゲリン監督が2007年に発表した長編劇映画。フランスの古都ストラスブールを舞台に、かつて出会った女性の面影を追い求める青年が街をさまよう姿を、緻密で独特な映像表現で描いた。 ヨーロッパの古都にあるホテルの一室で目覚めた画家志望の青年は、街のカフェで、かつてバーで会ったことのある美しい女性シルビアの姿を見つける。青年はそのシルビアと思しき女性を追いかけ、街中をさまよい歩くが……。 2007年・第64回ベネチア国際映画祭コンペティション部門に出品されたほか、2008年・第20回東京国際映画祭をはじめ各国で上映されて高い評価を獲得。「ミツバチのささやき」「エル・スール」で知られるスペインの名匠ビクトル・エリセが、ゲリンを「現代スペインで最も優れた映画作家」と称賛したことでも知られる。
tmdb_overview_en: A man returns to a city to try to track down a woman he met six years earlier.
synopsis_en: This film follows a young aspiring painter wandering through places of memory, searching for traces of Sylvia, a woman he loved six years ago. It constructs an obsessive love story reminiscent of Alfred Hitchcock's 'Vertigo' (1958) with meticulously calculated sound and imagery, resulting in a groundbreaking work unlike anything seen before. The film was shot entirely on location in Strasbourg, France, an ancient city where medieval streetscapes and cutting-edge railways coexist without dissonance, creating a stateless atmosphere. The masterful sound design, which orchestrates the city's noises—the murmur of people, the passing of trams—like a symphony, and the beautiful, luminous chain of images captured through glass reflections and tram windows, transport the viewer into an unknown, otherworldly space.

movie_title: ＜ロックの時間＞ チャック・ベリー　ブラウン・アイド・ハンサム・マン
movie_title_en: Chuck Berry: Brown Eyed Handsome Man
tmdb_overview_jp: ギタリストなら誰もがコピーする特徴的なギター・リフを発明し、ロックンロール音楽の創始者ともされるチャック・ベリー。2017年に90歳で亡くなるまで現役のロックンローラーとして活躍した彼のトリビュート番組が登場！　番組ではチャック・ベリーの演奏はもちろん、彼の楽曲をカバーするさまざまなミュージシャンの映像をたっぷりフィーチャー。 古くは1964年にザ・ビートルズがアメリカ初上陸した際にワシントン・コロシアムで演奏した「ロール・オーヴァー・ベートーヴェン」や同じく1964年にザ・ローリング・ストーンズがUK公演で演奏した「アラウンド・アンド・アラウンド」から、2017年にジェフ・リンがELOとしてロックの殿堂入りセレモニーで演奏した「ロール・オーヴァー・ベートーヴェン」まで。ポール・マッカートニーやトム・ペティ＆ザ・ハートブレイカーズ、キース・リチャーズ、リンダ・ロンシュタット、ブルース・スプリングスティーンも登場する豪華版だ！
tmdb_overview_en: "Chuck Berry-Brown Eyed Handsome Man" is a collection of performances by the greatest rock icons in history performing their favorite songs by their self-proclaimed hero Chuck Berry. For the first and possibly the only time ever you will see full performances from the legends of rock and roll honoring the man they agree started it all. The program is a historic record of the decades-long and continuing impact for the father of Rock 'N Roll. We are proud to present in just one program these superstars of Rock; The Beatles, the Rolling Stones, Bruce Springsteen, Tom Petty, Jimi Hendrix, Jeff Lynne, and more, all filmed at the heights of their own careers performing the work of Chuck Berry.
clean_title_jp: チャック・ベリー ブラウン・アイド・ハンサム・マン
movie_title_jp: チャック・ベリー ブラウン・アイド・ハンサム・マン
movie_title_original: Chuck Berry: Brown Eyed Handsome Man
synopsis_en: Produced for PBS as a tribute to Chuck Berry (1926–2017)—the founder of rock and roll who transcended barriers of race and generation to exert a profound influence on future artists, culture, and society. This documentary brings together rare footage of Berry’s signature songs performed by the man himself and the rock legends he inspired, including The Beatles, The Rolling Stones, Jimi Hendrix, Keith Richards, Paul McCartney, and Bruce Springsteen. These performances were collected with the permission of the artists and their estates, with many of them digitally remastered. The film is narrated by Danny Glover, star of *The Color Purple* and the *Lethal Weapon* series.

movie_title: ＜ロックの時間＞ エリック・クラプトン　アクロス24ナイツ
tmdb_overview_en: In 1990 and in 1991 Eric Clapton played 24 nights at the Royal Albert Hall performing with different line-ups and sets featuring Blues, Rock, and a full Orchestra. The performances have become legendary to Eric Clapton fans. Over thirty years later this film, edited from the original footage and completely remastered in Dolby Surround Sound, captures for the first time the definitive performances across all the sets over both years. The film features 17 hits from across his repertoires showing Clapton at his most exhilarating, collaborating with top musicians.
synopsis_en: A selection of the best performances from Eric Clapton's 42 concerts at London's Royal Albert Hall in the early 1990s, screened on the big screen. Clapton's 18 concerts at the venue in January-February 1990 were monumental, featuring various elaborate arrangements from a four-piece band to a 13-piece ensemble with a horn section, and collaborations with an orchestra. Furthermore, in February-March of the following year, 1991, he successfully completed 24 consecutive performances, including a blues night with guests Albert Collins and Buddy Guy, and evenings featuring the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra conducted by Michael Kamen. A total of 17 songs, including 13 previously unreleased tracks, are revived on screen with supreme sound and 4K imagery, including an orchestral prologue based on the classic "Layla." Directed by David Barnard, director of "Eric Clapton: Lockdown Sessions."

tmdb_overview_jp: 映画女優になる夢を抱くモ。しかし、万年エキストラのまま、回ってくる仕事は顔すら映らない端役や死体の役ばかり。ある日、役作りのプチ整形顔がスタッフの目に止まり、かつてのスター俳優マー主演の超大作「白雪姫 血のチャイナタウン」に抜擢された。だがマーは演技も性格も最低最悪。過去の栄光にすがるトラブルメーカーだった。落ちぶれ俳優マーと、底辺から脱しようと奮闘するモン。やがてこの出会いが、2人の人生を大きく変えていく──!!
tmdb_overview_en: A young female actor dreams of becoming famous and building a successful career despite being a stand-in and extra on most sets.
synopsis_en: Mo dreams of becoming a movie actress. But she remains a perpetual extra, and the only roles that come her way are bit parts where her face never even appears, or corpse roles. One day, her minor cosmetic surgery for a role catches the eye of a staff member, and she is selected for the blockbuster "Snow White: Bloody Chinatown," starring former star actor Ma. But Ma is the absolute worst in both acting and personality—a troublemaker clinging to past glory. A washed-up actor Ma, and Mon, fighting to climb out from the bottom. Before long, this encounter will drastically change both of their lives—!!

movie_title: ＜エッセンシャル・ヌーヴェルヴァーグ （特別上映）＞ パリところどころ　2K修復版
tmdb_overview_en: Six vignettes set in different sections of Paris, by six directors. St. Germain des Pres (Douchet), Gare du Nord (Rouch), Rue St. Denis (Pollet), and Montparnasse et Levallois (Godard) are stories of love, flirtation and prostitution; Place d'Etoile (Rohmer) concerns a haberdasher and his umbrella; and La Muette (Chabrol), a bourgeois family and earplugs.
synopsis_en: An omnibus film of short works, each directed by one of six leading directors of the French New Wave, all set against the backdrop of Paris. The six episodes are: "Saint-Denis Street" (directed by Jean-Daniel Pollet), about a timid man who brings a prostitute he met in a red-light district back to his apartment; "North Station" (Jean Rouch), about a woman living with her lover in an apartment far from the station who encounters an unexpected incident on her way to work after arguing with him; "Saint-Germain-des-Prés" (Jean Douchet), depicting the romantic entanglements of young people in a student quarter; "Place de l'Étoile" (Éric Rohmer), about a man heading to work through the Place de l'Étoile who faces a series of troubles; "Montparnasse and Levallois" (Jean-Luc Godard), about a woman who writes love letters to two different men but accidentally mails the wrong ones; and "La Muette" (Claude Chabrol), depicting a tragedy that strikes a bourgeois family in an upscale neighborhood from the son's perspective. The cast includes Joanna Shimkus from "The Adventurers," Stéphane Audran from "Babette's Feast," and Barbet Schroeder, who also produced this film, among others.

tmdb_overview_jp: 「勝手にしやがれ」のジャン＝リュック・ゴダールの長編第3作で、“登場人物が歌わないミュージカルコメディ”という発想に基づいて制作されたラブコメディ。キャバレーの踊り子アンジェラは一緒に暮らす恋人エミールに、今すぐに子どもが欲しいと言い出す。エミールはそんな彼女に戸惑いを隠せない。そこへ、アンジェラに想いを寄せる青年アルフレッドが現れ……。ゴダール監督の前作「小さな兵隊」に続いてアンナ・カリーナがヒロインを務め、「勝手にしやがれ」のジャン＝ポール・ベルモンドがアルフレッド、「いとこ同志」のジャン＝クロード・ブリアリがエミールを演じた。「シェルブールの雨傘」などの名作曲家ミシェル・ルグランが音楽を担当。
tmdb_overview_en: Longing for a baby, a stripper pursues another man in order to make her boyfriend jealous.
director_jp: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
synopsis_en: This is Jean-Luc Godard's third feature film, following "Breathless," and a romantic comedy created based on the idea of a "musical comedy in which the characters do not sing." Angela, a cabaret dancer, tells her live-in lover Émile that she wants a child right now. Émile cannot hide his bewilderment at her request. Then a young man named Alfred, who has feelings for Angela, appears... Following Godard's previous film "Le Petit Soldat," Anna Karina plays the heroine, with Jean-Paul Belmondo of "Breathless" as Alfred and Jean-Claude Brialy of "Les Cousins" as Émile. The music is by Michel Legrand, the renowned composer of "The Umbrellas of Cherbourg" and other films.

tmdb_overview_en: Twelve episodic tales in the life of a Parisian woman and her slow descent into prostitution.
movie_title_original: Vivre sa vie: film en douze tableaux
director_jp: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
synopsis_en: This is Jean-Luc Godard's fourth feature film, following "A Woman Is a Woman," and was shot starring Anna Karina, his partner both publicly and privately. Nana, who decides to part ways with her husband after discussing life with him at a café in Paris, falls into a life where she cannot even pay her rent. She begins to proposition men on the street and engage in prostitution. Eventually, Nana becomes numb to having relations with strangers. The music was handled by Michel Legrand, the renowned composer of "The Umbrellas of Cherbourg" and other films.

director: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
tmdb_overview_en: Cinephile slackers Franz and Arthur spend their days mimicking the antiheroes of Hollywood noirs and Westerns while pursuing the lovely Odile. The misfit trio upends convention at every turn, be it through choreographed dances in cafés or frolicsome romps through the Louvre. Eventually, their romantic view of outlaws pushes them to plan their own heist, but their inexperience may send them out in a blaze of glory -- which could be just what they want.
director_jp: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
synopsis_en: A masterpiece from Jean-Luc Godard's early period, this melodrama is based on an American crime novel and depicts in comedic fashion the love triangle and criminal scheme involving two men and one woman. Winter in Paris. Franz and Arthur, best friends with completely opposite personalities, both fall in love at first sight with Odile, a beautiful and shy woman from Scandinavia. One day, they learn that a large sum of money is hidden in Odile's aunt's house, and the three plot to steal it, but the plan takes unexpected twists and turns... This was the first production from "Anouchka Films," the production company founded by Godard and actress Anna Karina, who played Odile and were married at the time. Music by Michel Legrand of "The Umbrellas of Cherbourg." It went unreleased in Japanese theaters for many years before finally premiering in 2001.

tmdb_overview_jp: 映画女優になる夢を抱くモ。しかし、万年エキストラのまま、回ってくる仕事は顔すら映らない端役や死体の役ばかり。ある日、役作りのプチ整形顔がスタッフの目に止まり、かつてのスター俳優マー主演の超大作「白雪姫 血のチャイナタウン」に抜擢された。だがマーは演技も性格も最低最悪。過去の栄光にすがるトラブルメーカーだった。落ちぶれ俳優マーと、底辺から脱しようと奮闘するモン。やがてこの出会いが、2人の人生を大きく変えていく──!!
tmdb_overview_en: A young female actor dreams of becoming famous and building a successful career despite being a stand-in and extra on most sets.
synopsis_en: Mo dreams of becoming a movie actress. But she remains a perpetual extra, and the only roles that come her way are bit parts where her face never even appears, or corpse roles. One day, her minor cosmetic surgery for a role catches the eye of a staff member, and she is selected for the blockbuster "Snow White: Bloody Chinatown," starring former star actor Ma. But Ma is the absolute worst in both acting and personality—a troublemaker clinging to past glory. A washed-up actor Ma, and Mon, fighting to climb out from the bottom. Before long, this encounter will drastically change both of their lives—!!

director: リチャード・リンクレイター
country: フランス 原題または英題：Nouvelle Vague
synopsis: 「6才のボクが、大人になるまで。」「ビフォア」シリーズのリチャード・リンクレイター監督が、1950年代後半のフランスで起きた革新的な映画運動・ヌーベルバーグを代表する作品として知られるジャン＝リュック・ゴダール監督作「勝手にしやがれ」製作の舞台裏を映画化。映画史に革命を起こした若者たちの姿を、フランス映画界を代表する映画作家たちとの活気ある交流とともに描き出す。 1959年、フランス。映画批評誌「カイエ・デュ・シネマ」で執筆活動をしていた28歳のジャン＝リュック・ゴダールは、フランスの若手俳優ジャン＝ポール・ベルモンドとアメリカの人気女優ジーン・セバーグを主演に迎えた長編監督デビュー作「勝手にしやがれ」の制作を開始する。ゴダールの斬新で自由奔放な撮影手法に周囲は振り回されるが、映画づくりへの情熱を共有した撮影現場は活気に満ちていく。 「勝手にしやがれ」のスタイルにならい、アカデミー比率（1:1.37）の白黒映像、全編ほぼフランス語で、キャストもジーン・セバーグ役のゾーイ・ドゥイッチ以外はほぼ無名の俳優陣で固めた。主人公ゴダール役には、写真家やモデルとして活動していたギョーム・マルベックを起用。2025年・第78回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門出品。
tmdb_overview_en: Composed entirely of literary quotations from many different sources and from several historical periods, the loose narrative concerns a drifter found by a rich woman who soon falls in love with him. A drowning accident takes place and the drifter dies, but some time later he reappears in the woman’s life looking for a job. Or could it be the man’s twin brother?
director_jp: ジャン＝リュック・ゴダール
synopsis_en: From the director of "Boyhood" and the "Before" series, Richard Linklater, comes a film that goes behind the scenes of Jean-Luc Godard's "Breathless"—a landmark work of the French New Wave, the revolutionary film movement that emerged in the late 1950s. It depicts the young people who sparked a revolution in film history, along with their vibrant interactions with the leading filmmakers of French cinema. In 1959, France. Jean-Luc Godard, a 28-year-old critic writing for the film magazine "Cahiers du Cinéma," begins production on his feature directorial debut, "Breathless," starring French up-and-coming actor Jean-Paul Belmondo and American starlet Jean Seberg. Those around him are thrown off by Godard's innovative and freewheeling shooting methods, but the set, fueled by a shared passion for filmmaking, is filled with energy. Following the style of "Breathless," the film is shot in black and white in the Academy ratio (1:1.37), almost entirely in French, and the cast, except for Zoey Deutch as Jean Seberg, is made up of mostly unknown actors. Guillaume Marbeck, who worked as a photographer and model, was cast as the protagonist Godard. The film was selected for the Competition section of the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025.

tmdb_overview_jp: 妻を病気で亡くしたティーは工事現場で働きながら一人息子のディッキーを一流私立小学校に通わせている。ディッキーの欲しがる運動靴を拾いに行ったゴミ捨て場で、ティーは緑色のボールを見つける。ティーが持ち帰ったボールから生まれた生物（かどうか不明な物体）をディッキーはミラクル7号と呼んで飼い始める。
tmdb_overview_en: A poor construction worker, who struggles to keep his son in private school, mistakes an orb he finds in a junkjard for a toy which proves to be much, much more once the young boy starts to play with it.
genres: サイエンスフィクション
synopsis_en: Ti, who lost his wife to illness, works at a construction site to send his only son Dicky to a prestigious private elementary school. While retrieving a pair of sneakers Dicky wanted from the garbage dump, Ti finds a green ball. Dicky begins keeping the creature (or is it an object of unknown nature?) that is born from the ball Ti brought home, naming it Miracle 7.

movie_title: ＜ロックの時間＞ ザ・ビートルズ・アンド・インディア
tmdb_overview_en: Explores the The Beatles’ love affair with India, its religions and its culture and, in turn, the impact of their music and style on a young generation in India.

director: ホセ・ルイス・ゲリン
country: スペイン・フランス合作 原題または英題：Historias del buen valle
synopsis: 「シルビアのいる街で」などで知られるスペインの名匠ホセ・ルイス・ゲリンの10年ぶりとなる長編監督作で、バルセロナ郊外の集落・バルボナ地区を舞台に、変わりゆく時代と人々の生活を見つめたドキュメンタリー。 スペインのバルセロナ郊外に位置するバルボナ地区。「よき谷」と名付けられたこの地は川や線路に囲まれ、開発から取り残された陸の孤島であり、大都市の近くとは思えないほど豊かな自然に恵まれている。ここには20世紀半ばに移り住んできた人々と、最近になってやってきた新世代の移民たちが共に暮らしている。インド、ジャマイカ、ロシア、ウクライナなど世界中から集まってきた彼らは文化も生活スタイルも異なるが、子どもたちは一緒に川で遊び、誰もがよく食べて飲んで歌い、踊り、ひとときの安らぎを得る。そんな都会のオアシスのような地に鉄道増設の計画が持ち上がり、一部の人々は立ち退きを迫られてしまう。 ゲリン監督が3年の歳月をかけてバルボナ地区にカメラを向け、愛情を込めながら住民たちの生活を記録。ひとつの小さな地区を舞台に、そこに生き続ける市井の人々と、流れ続ける人類の営みを詩情ゆたかに映し出す。2025年・第73回サン・セバスティアン国際映画祭で審査員特別賞を受賞。
tmdb_overview_jp: スペイン、バルセロナ郊外に位置するバルボナ地区。“よき⾕”と名付けられたこの場所は川や線路に囲まれ、開発から取り残された陸の孤島でありながら、⼤都市の近くとは思えないほどの豊かな⾃然に恵まれた理想郷のようでもある。ここには 20 世紀半ばから移り住んだ住⺠の家族と、最近になってやってきた新世代の移⺠たちが共に暮らしている。⽂化や⽣活スタイルは異なるものの、⼦供たちはともに川で遊び、誰もがよく⾷べて飲んで、歌い、踊り、ひとときの安らぎを得る。そんな都会のオアシスに、新しく鉄道増設の計画が持ち上がった。住⺠説明会が開かれ、⼀部の⼈々は⽴ち退きを迫られるが……。
tmdb_overview_en: In a peripheral neighbourhood, where the rural and urban worlds meet, the houses of the first migrants who arrived after the post-war period coexist with the new blocks of the dormitory city, where the latest wave of migration is concentrated. This humble corner is now an authentic global village. Good Valley Stories is a sum of constructs, of social, generational and identity, urban and ecological conflicts, but it is also a calm and humanistic look at today’s world.
synopsis_en: A new feature film from director José Luis Guerín, who captivated the world with 'In the City of Sylvia' (2007) and was called 'the most outstanding filmmaker in contemporary Spain' by fellow Spanish director Víctor Erice. Despite his sparse output, Guerín continues to create masterpieces that lightly transcend the boundaries between fiction and documentary. This is his long-awaited new film, his first in ten years since 'The Academy of Muses' (2015), now arriving in Japan. To commemorate the release of 'The Good Valley Story,' the beautiful masterpiece 'In the City of Sylvia' will also be revived. Please enjoy Guerín's world on the big screen. The Vallbona district, located on the outskirts of Barcelona, Spain. This place, named 'The Good Valley,' is surrounded by rivers and railway tracks, an isolated land left behind by development, yet it also seems like an ideal paradise blessed with nature so rich it's hard to believe it's near a big city. Here, families who moved in from the mid-20th century live together with a new generation of immigrants who have arrived recently. Although their cultures and lifestyles differ, the children play together in the river, and everyone eats, drinks, sings, and dances well, finding a moment of peace. A new railway expansion plan is proposed for this urban oasis. A residents' information meeting is held, and some people are forced to relocate...

movie_title: ＜ロックの時間＞ レッツ・ロック・アゲイン！
movie_title_jp: ＜ロックの時間＞ レッツ・ロック・アゲイン！

tmdb_overview_jp: 1930年代の上海は、新興の暴力組織、斧頭会が牛耳っていた。猪籠城寨（豚小屋砦）と呼ばれる貧困者アパートにチンピラのシンとその相棒が斧頭会を名乗り恐喝に来た。住人を舐めていたが逆にボコボコにされ、苦し紛れに投げた爆竹で偶然通りかかった斧頭会幹部に怪我をさせてしまう。
tmdb_overview_en: It's the 1940s, and the notorious Axe Gang terrorizes Shanghai. Small-time criminals Sing and Bone hope to join, but they only manage to make lots of very dangerous enemies. Fortunately for them, kung fu masters and hidden strength can be found in unlikely places. Now they just have to take on the entire Axe Gang.
synopsis_en: A wuxia fantasy action film directed by Taiwanese director Giddens Ko of 'The Secrets in the Lattice' and 'You Are the Apple of My Eye,' starring Ko Chen-tung, who collaborated with Ko on those two previous films. Director Giddens Ko, also active as a novelist, adapts his own internet-published novel 'Kung Fu' for the screen, weaving in homages to Hong Kong and Taiwanese wuxia films from the 1980s and 90s throughout. Underachieving high school student Yuan Zai and his best friend A Yi encounter a mysterious drifter, Huang Jun, who has awakened from a 500-year slumber. Witnessing Huang Jun's overwhelming martial arts prowess as a kung fu master, Yuan Zai and A Yi become his disciples. Their classmate Yi Jing, on whom Yuan Zai has a secret crush, also joins their training. They soon learn of the centuries-old feud between Huang Jun and his junior disciple Lan Jin, and uncover a momentous secret hidden within 'kung fu' that could shake heaven and earth. Ko Chen-tung plays Yuan Zai, Berant Zhu of 'Black Education' plays A Yi, Wang Jing of 'The Secrets in the Lattice' and 'The Return of the Condor Heroes' plays Yi Jing, veteran actor Tai Li-len plays the mysterious kung fu master Huang Jun, and Liu Kuan-ting of 'The Girl Who Robbed Time' plays Huang Jun's nemesis Lan Jin.

Director No Yeong-seon, based in France, turns her gaze on three generations of women in her family—her mother living on Ganghwa Island, South Korea, and her grandmother who died in Okinawa during the war—who lived knowing little of each other. Through the universal question, 'Can we mourn those we have no memory of?' she depicts the transmission of war memories in this documentary. Director No, living in France, has a mother who lives on Ganghwa Island where she was born and raised. Her grandmother, during the end of World War II under Japanese colonial rule, followed her Korean lover from Japan to Seoul. The mother and grandmother were separated during the chaos of the Korean War, so the mother has no memory of the grandmother. Director No tentatively calls this grandmother 'Yukiko' and, using the two islands—Ganghwa Island where her mother lives and Okinawa, which Yukiko chose as her final resting place—as settings, intimately portrays the three generations of women while quietly examining the transmission of war memories through the question, 'Can we mourn those we have no memory of?' The film was screened in the International Competition section of the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival in 2019, one of Asia's largest documentary film festivals. It will be shown in August 2026 at Cinema Rise in Jimbocho, Tokyo, as part of the 'Yama-Doc Teiki-bin' program, which screens films related to the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival.

tmdb_overview_jp: かつて不当な理由で投獄されたワヒドは、ある偶然によって、自分の人生を奪った看守に出会う。咄嗟に男を拘束し、荒野に穴を掘り埋めようとするが、男は人違いだと言う。実はワヒドは、男の顔を見たことがなかった。男は、本当に復讐の相手なのか？一旦復讐を中断し、同じ男に拷問された友人を訪ねることにするが･･･。
tmdb_overview_en: An unassuming mechanic is reminded of his time in an Iranian prison when he encounters a man he suspects to be his sadistic jailhouse captor.
clean_title_jp: シンプル・アクシデント／偶然
movie_title_jp: シンプル・アクシデント／偶然
synopsis_en: A suspense thriller by Iranian master Jafar Panahi, winner of the Palme d'Or at the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025. It thrillingly and humorously depicts people wrongfully imprisoned seeking revenge. Vahid, once unjustly imprisoned, accidentally encounters a man he believes was his torturer guard. He forcibly restrains the man and digs a hole in the wilderness to bury him, but the man's ID card shows a different name. The man claims it's a case of mistaken identity. Blindfolded during imprisonment, Vahid never saw his torturer's face. Unsure if this is the right man, Vahid pauses revenge and visits a friend who was also tortured by the same guard. Panahi, banned from filmmaking by the Iranian government for opposition activities, drew inspiration from his own two imprisonments and the real voices of cellmates. Having won the Golden Lion at Venice for 'The Circle' and 'No Bears', and the Golden Bear at Berlin for 'Taxi', Panahi achieved the feat of winning top prizes at all three major festivals with this film. A French co-production, it was France's entry for Best International Feature Film at the 98th Academy Awards and received a nomination.
