synopsis: 東映動画の第1作は、「絵が動く」原初的な喜びにあふれた珠玉の短篇『こねこのらくがき』。森康二の作画が命を吹き込んだ子猫やネズミは続篇『こねこのスタジオ』でも格別の愛らしさを備えていて、東映動画が得意とする動物キャラクターの表現が、この時点ですでに洗練されていたことがうかがえる。また、TVアニメ制作が始まるまで、短篇は若手が抜擢される貴重な場となり、月岡貞夫や池田宏が演出デビューを果たしている。（8/25 更新）
synopsis_en: Toei Dōga's first work was the gem of a short film "Koneko no Rakugaki," brimming with the primal joy of "pictures moving." From its sequel "Koneko no Studio" through "Mogura no Motoro," the animals brought to life by Mori Yasuji's animation possess a special charm, and it is clear that the expression of animal characters, a Toei Dōga specialty, was already refined at this early stage. Until TV animation production began, these shorts served as a valuable platform for young talent, with Shirakawa Daisaku and Ikeda Hiroshi making their directorial debuts.

movie_title: 白蛇伝［デジタル復元版］
synopsis: 日本初の長篇カラーアニメーション映画。アニメーションの海外配給に商機を見た東映社長・大川博のもと、白蛇の精と人間の青年の愛を描く中国の説話が題材に選ばれた。原画担当は森康二と大工原章というベテランふたりのみで、6万5千枚におよぶ動画を仕上げたスタッフの多くは経験1年未満の新人であった。本篇前に復元デモ（2分）を上映。
tmdb_overview_jp: 白蛇の精・白娘は、幼い頃可愛がってくれた許仙のことが忘れられず美しい娘となって彼の前に姿を現した。二人を手引きするのは、魚の精の少青。たちまち二人は恋に陥ってしまう。しかし、このことはたちまち法海和尚の知るところとなり、妖怪に魅入られた若者の命を慮る和尚は、法力をもってこの恋を妨げようと決意するのであった。だが、二人の恋は上々の首尾で花咲き乱れる美しい屋敷の庭をそぞろ歩くなど、夢うつつのひとときを過ごしていた。許仙と仲良しのパンダとミミーの二匹も、少青と一緒に屋敷の中を遊びあるき、あげくの果てに柱の飾り龍を引きずり落としてしまった。龍は勝手に動き出し、パンダとミミーそして少青をつかまらせたまま、夜空を飛び回って宝物殿に落ちた。少青はそこで拾った宝石を許仙と白娘に与えたが、これが二人を引き離すもとになる。
tmdb_overview_en: As a young boy, Xu-Xian is forced to free his pet, a small snake. Unbeknownst to him, the snake is actually a young snake goddess named Bai-Niang and she is in love with him. Many years later, when they are both adults, the princess is magically transformed into a human and sets out to find her love. But the local wizard believes her to be a vampire, and banishes Xu-Xian from the village in order to save him. Xu-Xian's pet pandas Panda and Mimi set out to save him and bring him, in the process becoming leaders of an animal gang.
movie_title_en: The Tale of the White Serpent
synopsis_en: The white snake spirit Bai Niang, unable to forget Xu Xian who cared for her when she was young, appears before him as a beautiful woman. The fish spirit Shao Qing acts as their go-between. The two quickly fall in love. However, this soon comes to the attention of the monk Fa Hai, who, concerned for the life of the young man bewitched by a demon, decides to use his magical powers to obstruct their love. Yet their romance seems to be progressing smoothly, as they spend dreamlike moments strolling through the garden of a beautiful mansion in full bloom. Xu Xian's close friends, the panda and Mimi, also playfully roam the mansion with Shao Qing, eventually pulling down a decorative dragon from a pillar. The dragon moves on its own, capturing the panda, Mimi, and Shao Qing, flying through the night sky and dropping them into a treasure hall. Shao Qing gives the jewels she finds there to Xu Xian and Bai Niang, but this becomes the cause of their separation.

director: ミケランジェロ・フランマルティーノ
country: イタリア
tmdb_overview_en: An old shepherd lives his last days in a quiet medieval village perched high on the hills of Calabria, at the southernmost tip of Italy. He herds goats under skies that most villagers have deserted long ago. He is sick, and believes to find his medicine in the dust he collects on the church floor, which he drinks in his water every day.
director_jp: ミケランジェロ・フランマルティーノ
synopsis_en: Italian filmmaker Michelangelo Frammartino tells the story of four lives that are born and die. Based on the Pythagorean concept of "four transmigrations," the film presents humans, animals, plants, and minerals with equal weight from a fundamentally egalitarian perspective that does not center the human world. After an elderly shepherd quietly dies in a mountain village in Calabria, southern Italy, his young goat dies beside a large fir tree. The tree is cut down for a village festival and eventually becomes charcoal. With no dialogue and long takes, the film captures nature as it is. In Japan, it screened in the natural TIFF section of the 23rd Tokyo International Film Festival in 2010 and was released theatrically in 2011. It will be released in 2026 as part of the special screening series "The Amazing World of Michelangelo Frammartino."

director: ミケランジェロ・フランマルティーノ
country: イタリア
tmdb_overview_en: In August 1961, speleologists from Italy’s booming North arrive on a Calabrian plateau where time stands still. The intruders discover one of the world’s deepest caves, the Bifurto Abyss, under the gaze of an old shepherd, the only witness of the pristine territory.
director_jp: ミケランジェロ・フランマルティーノ
synopsis_en: Director Michelangelo Frammartino, whose "Four Lives" depicting the cycle of life earned high praise at the Cannes Film Festival, questions the meaning of humanity's venture into the unknown against the historical context of Italy's economic boom. This film won the Special Jury Prize in the Competition section of the 78th Venice International Film Festival in 2021. Young explorers descend 683 meters underground without maps, using acetylene lamps to measure and map the cave structure. Above ground, an elderly shepherd on the Pollino Plateau prepares for a quiet death amidst vast nature, suffering from illness. The shepherd's death coincides with the explorers reaching the deepest abyss, creating a grand cycle of life and death, time and space. The cinematographer is the renowned Renato Berta, known for collaborations with masters like Jean-Luc Godard, Éric Rohmer, Daniel Schmid, and Manoel de Oliveira. In Japan, it screened under the title "Cave" in the World Focus section of the 34th Tokyo International Film Festival. It will have its theatrical premiere in Japan in 2026 under the title "Journey to the Depths of the Earth" as part of the special screening series "The Amazing World of Michelangelo Frammartino."

movie_title: 一口のパン＋夜のダイヤモンド
country: チェコスロバキア
movie_title_jp: 一口のパン＋夜のダイヤモンド

country: チェコスロバキア
tmdb_overview_en: In Nazi-occupied Czechoslovakia, a doctor-turned-warehouse employee reluctantly agrees to treat a gravely wounded political fugitive, putting himself and everyone living in his building complex in danger.
synopsis_en: Set in Nazi-occupied Czechoslovakia, this drama portrays the terror of an informant society during wartime. Dr. Braun, a Jew living in Nazi-occupied Czechoslovakia, is forbidden from practicing medicine. The elderly man seems to have already accepted the fate of the Jews. Then one day, a neighbor asks him to treat a wounded political fugitive, and he reluctantly provides care. Eventually confronting his inner self, Dr. Braun decides to continue illegal treatment for the resistance to reclaim his identity. He wanders the streets of Prague in search of the morphine needed for this, but... Through the various people Dr. Braun meets and the wartime cityscape, the film depicts a society decaying and collapsing under war with hallucinatory visual beauty. In Japan, it will have its theatrical premiere in April 2026 as part of "Czech Film Masterpieces," a series featuring classics of the Czech New Wave.

country: チェコスロバキア
tmdb_overview_jp: プラハの小さな葬儀社で火葬人として働くカレル・コップフルキングルは、家族を愛する平凡な男だった。ある時、第1次世界大戦中にともに戦った戦友と再会するが、彼はナチ党の一員となっていた。友人に地元のユダヤ人社会を監視するよう説得されたカレルは、次第に友人や社会情勢に影響されていき……。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1930s Prague, a Czech cremator who firmly believes cremation relieves one from earthly suffering is drawn inexorably to Nazism.
synopsis_en: Set in Prague, Czechoslovakia on the eve of World War II, this dark comedy depicts how an ordinary citizen working at a funeral home is influenced by his pro-Nazi friend and the social climate, driving him toward a disastrous solution. Karel Kopfrkingl, who works as a cremator at a small Prague funeral home, is an ordinary man who loves his family. One day, he reunites with a war buddy from World War I, who has become a member of the Nazi Party. Persuaded by his friend to monitor the local Jewish community, Karel gradually becomes influenced by his friend and the social situation... The film portrays how an utterly ordinary person becomes a perpetrator, using beautiful yet eerie expressionistic imagery. This work, which exposes the terror of totalitarian ideology, was banned in its home country of Czechoslovakia and could not be shown until the fall of the communist regime in 1990. It won the Grand Prize at the 5th Sitges - Catalonian International Film Festival. In Japan, it will have its theatrical premiere in April 2026 as part of "Czech Film Masterpieces," a series featuring classics of the Czech New Wave.

movie_title: キラー・オブ・シープ
country: アメリカ
tmdb_overview_en: An African-American man working at a slaughterhouse in the Watts area of Los Angeles leads a dissatisfied and listless existence.
synopsis_en: The feature debut of Charles Burnett, a filmmaker who quietly revolutionized American cinema by depicting the daily lives and humanity of African Americans, released in 1977. It portrays the everyday existence of African American workers living on the fringes of Los Angeles with a realistic gaze and poetic visual beauty. Set in the Watts district of Los Angeles in the early 1970s, still bearing the scars of the Watts riots. Stan works at a sheep slaughterhouse to support his wife and two children, living an empty daily life. Exhausted physically and mentally by labor and poverty, he withdraws into himself, while his wife grows increasingly lonely. Directed by Burnett as his graduate thesis film while a student at UCLA Film School, it was shot in Watts using a mostly amateur cast of people he knew. Long unreleased due to music copyright issues, it finally had a theatrical release in the US in 2007. The 4K restoration completed in 2025 replaces the music in the final scene with Dinah Washington's "Unforgettable," as Burnett originally intended. It won the FIPRESCI Prize at the Forum section of the 31st Berlin International Film Festival in 1981. In Japan, it will have its first theatrical release in the 4K restored version as part of the special screening series "Charles Burnett: Everyday Blues" (starting February 7, 2026, at Theater Image Forum).

movie_title: マイ・ブラザーズ・ウェディング〈ディレクターズ・カット〉
country: アメリカ
movie_title_jp: マイ・ブラザーズ・ウェディング〈ディレクターズ・カット〉

country: イタリア
synopsis_en: This is the feature debut of 2003 by Michelangelo Frammartino, a solitary and distinctive filmmaker in Italian cinema. Starring the director's grandfather, Angelo Frammartino, it quietly depicts the final days of an old man's life with unique humor, set in a small Calabrian village on the verge of abandonment due to depopulation. An old man lives in a depopulating rural village in southern Italy. One day, young men who help him bury his old dog leave behind a cell phone and a scrap of paper—a nude photo taken for personal purposes. Later, the old man notices a woman in the village; she is the person in the photo. Using no professional actors, filming with local residents, the film creates a quiet visual poem exploring universal themes of "tradition and modernity," "life and death," and "community and solitude." It will have its Japanese theatrical premiere in 2026 in a 4K restored version as part of the special screening series "The Amazing World of Michelangelo Frammartino."

synopsis: かいせつ 戦乱の世、欲望に駆られた男たちは、女たちを犠牲にしてまで幻影を追い求め…。怪異譚の古典を原作に、欲に惑う人間の愚かさを、現実と幻想の間に映し出す名作。ヴェネチア映画祭銀獅子賞に輝き、溝口の名を世界に轟かせた。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 戦国の世、貧しい陶工・源十郎が若狭姫という女性と知り合い、生活をともにするようになる。だが美しい若狭姫の正体は死霊であった。それを知った源十郎は若狭姫を捨てて故郷に逃げるが、彼女の怨念は執拗に追いすがる……。「雨月物語」をベースに、川口松太郎らが脚色。
tmdb_overview_en: In 16th century Japan, peasants Genjuro and Tobei sell their earthenware pots to a group of soldiers in a nearby village, in defiance of a local sage's warning against seeking to profit from warfare. Genjuro's pursuit of both riches and the mysterious Lady Wakasa, as well as Tobei's desire to become a samurai, run the risk of destroying both themselves and their wives, Miyagi and Ohama.
synopsis_en: Commentary: In an age of war, men driven by lust chase illusions even at the cost of sacrificing women... Based on a classic tale of the supernatural, this masterpiece reflects the folly of humans deluded by desire, suspended between reality and fantasy. Winner of the Silver Lion at the Venice Film Festival, it spread Mizoguchi's name worldwide.

synopsis: かいせつ 平安時代、親と引き離された厨子王と安寿は、奴隷として売られてしまう―。中世の説話をもとにした鷗外の短編の映画化で、ヴェネチア国際映画祭で銀獅子賞に輝いた不朽の名作。名キャメラマン・宮川がとらえた映像美にも感服。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 森鴎外の同名小説を、八尋不二と依田義賢が共同で脚色し、溝口健二がメガホンをとった文芸作品。特に美術と撮影はレベルが高く、ヴェネチア国際映画祭で銀獅子賞を受賞した。美しいラストシーンは、ゴダールが「気狂いピエロ」において引用したことでも知られる。 　平安時代末期、農民を救うため将軍にたてついた平正氏が左遷された。妻の玉木、娘の安寿と息子の厨子王は越後を旅している途中、人買いにだまされ離ればなれになってしまう。玉木は佐渡に、安寿と厨子王は丹後の山椒大夫に奴隷として売られた。きょうだいはそれから十年もの間、奴隷としての生活を続けるが、ついに意を決して逃げ出すことにする。しかし追っ手に迫られ、安寿は厨子王を逃すため池に身を投げるのだった。
tmdb_overview_en: In 11th-century feudal Japan, following the exile of an idealistic governor, his wife and children are separated by slave traders; the children, Zushio and Anju, are sold into brutal servitude under the cruel bailiff Sansho.
synopsis_en: Commentary: In the Heian period, Zushio and Anju, separated from their parents, are sold into slavery... A film adaptation of Ogai's short story based on a medieval folktale, this timeless masterpiece won the Silver Lion at the Venice International Film Festival. The visual beauty captured by the renowned cinematographer Miyagawa is also awe-inspiring.

synopsis: かいせつ 古寺の山門に立つ老街娼(田中)は、自らの流転の人生を回想していた…。家筋も良く御所勤めの経験もある娘が、いかにして身を落としたのか―。溝口・田中コンビの最高傑作との呼び声も高く、ヴェネチア映画祭で国際賞を受賞した。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 奈良の荒れ寺に集まる街娼たち。年老いたお春は羅漢堂に入り、過去に出会った男の面影を思い浮かべていた。御所勤めをしていた13歳のお春は、公卿の勝之介に宿に連れ込まれたところを見つかり、両親ともども洛外へ追放となってしまった。その後、松平家に取り立てられ嗣子をもうけたものの、側近の裏切りに遭い実家へ帰されてしまう。島原の郭に売られたお春は、気に入られた客の住み込み女中となるが、その妻に嫉妬され追い出されてしまった。さらに結婚相手が急死し、世話になった男の盗みが発覚して捕らえられるなど、流転の人生を歩むのだった。
tmdb_overview_en: During the Edo Period, a noblewoman's banishment for her love affair with a lowly page signals the beginning of her inexorable fall.
synopsis_en: Commentary: An old street prostitute (Tanaka) standing at the gate of an ancient temple recalls her tumultuous life... How did a girl from a good family with experience serving at the imperial court fall so low? Hailed as the greatest masterpiece of the Mizoguchi-Tanaka partnership, it won an international award at the Venice Film Festival.

country: フランス・日本・ドイツ・ベルギー合作
synopsis: 「ドライブ・マイ・カー」「悪は存在しない」の濱口竜介監督が、パリを舞台に同じ名前の響きを持つ女性2人の魂の邂逅を描いたドラマ。がんの転移を経験しながら生き抜く哲学者・宮野真生子と、臨床現場の調査を積み重ねた人類学者・磯野真穂が交わした20通の往復書簡「急に具合が悪くなる」を原作に、偶然出会った2人の女性の交流と世界に対峙する姿を描き出す。 パリ郊外の介護施設「自由の庭」で施設長を務めるマリー＝ルー・フォンテーヌは、入居者を人間らしくケアすることを理想としながらも、人手不足やスタッフの無理解に悩まされていた。そんな中、日本人の舞台演出家・森崎真理と出会ったマリー＝ルーは、がん闘病中の彼女が描く演劇に勇気をもらう。同じ名前の響きを持つ偶然に導かれて交流を始める真理とマリー＝ルーだったが、あるとき真理は急に具合が悪くなる。真理の病の進行とともに2人の関係は深まり、互いの魂を通わせ合うようになっていく。 「ベネデッタ」のビルジニー・エフィラがマリー＝ルー、「ウルヴァリン：SAMURAI」などハリウッド映画にも出演する世界的ファッションモデルのTAOこと岡本多緒が真理を演じ、真理が演出する舞台の出演俳優・清宮吾朗役で「敵」の名優・長塚京三、吾朗の孫・窪寺智樹役で「見はらし世代」の注目若手俳優・黒崎煌代が共演。2026年・第79回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門に出品され、ビルジニー・エフィラと岡本多緒がそろって女優賞を受賞。岡本は日本人で初のカンヌ国際映画祭女優賞受賞を果たした。
tmdb_overview_jp: パリ郊外の介護施設「自由の庭」で施設長を務めるマリー＝ルー・フォンテーヌは、入居者を人間らしくケアすることを理想としながらも、人手不足やスタッフの無理解に悩まされていた。そんな中、日本人の舞台演出家・森崎真理と出会ったマリー＝ルーは、がん闘病中の彼女が描く演劇に勇気をもらう。同じ名前の響きを持つ偶然に導かれて交流を始める真理とマリー＝ルーだったが、あるとき真理は急に具合が悪くなる。真理の病の進行とともに2人の関係は深まり、互いの魂を通わせ合うようになっていく。
tmdb_overview_en: Marie-Lou Fontaine, director of a nursing home in the Paris suburbs, defies convention by adopting the 'Humanitude' method despite her team’s resistance. Her encounter with Mari Morisaki, a terminally ill Japanese playwright, transforms her life. Together, they turn the facility into a symbol of resistance and humanity against the system’s limits.
synopsis_en: Director Ryusuke Hamaguchi ("Drive My Car," "Evil Does Not Exist") portrays the spiritual encounter of two women with the same-sounding name in Paris. Based on the exchange of 20 letters between philosopher Makiko Miyano, who survived cancer metastasis, and anthropologist Maho Isono, titled "Suddenly Feeling Ill," the film depicts the connection between two women who meet by chance and their confrontation with the world. Marie-Lou Fontaine, director of the care facility "Garden of Freedom" on the outskirts of Paris, struggles with staff shortages and misunderstanding while striving for humane care. She meets Japanese stage director Mari Morisaki, who is battling cancer, and draws courage from her theater work. Guided by the coincidence of their similar-sounding names, Marie-Lou and Mari begin a friendship. But one day, Mari suddenly falls ill. As her illness progresses, their bond deepens, and their souls connect. Virginie Efira ("Benedetta") plays Marie-Lou, and Tao Okamoto, a global fashion model who has appeared in Hollywood films like "The Wolverine," plays Mari. Kyozo Nagatsuka ("Enemy") plays Goro Seimiya, an actor in Mari's play, and Koyo Kuroki ("The Generation of the Looking-Ahead") plays Tomoki Kubodera, Goro's grandson. Screened in the Competition section of the 79th Cannes Film Festival in 2026, Virginie Efira and Tao Okamoto jointly won the Best Actress award. Okamoto became the first Japanese person to win the Cannes Best Actress award.

country: 日本
synopsis: すれ違う夫婦の現在と、かつての記憶を揺さぶる友人との再会を、過去と現在を交錯させながら描いたラブストーリー。「春みたいだ」「窓たち」などの短編作品で注目を集めた志萱大輔が長編初監督を務め、7年の制作期間を経て完成させた。 音楽家のモリは、写真家である妻マイコとの距離を埋められず悩んでいた。そんなある日、モリはかつての友人アサコと思いがけない再会を果たし、彼女への古い愛情を呼び起こされる。アサコもまた、かつて自分がモリにひかれていたことを思い出す。しかし、ふたりの記憶は期待や欲望を含みながら、ぼやけ、歪み、それぞれの中で都合よく書き換えられて現れる。そして長い散歩のあとで、モリとアサコは既に軌道を外れてしまったふたつの人生と、それぞれが立つ現在を改めて見つめ直していく。 シンガーソングライター「soma」としても活動する俳優の藤井草馬がモリ役で主演を務め、音楽も担当。「息を殺して」の谷口蘭がモリの妻マイコ、「オーガスト・マイ・ヘヴン」の村上由規乃がモリのかつての友人アサコを演じた。2025年・第30回釜山国際映画祭コンペティション部門出品作品。
tmdb_overview_en: Plagued by insomnia and lethargy, Mori lets time drift aimlessly, unable to create any meaningful music, all while uneasily sharing a home with his wife, Maiko, a successful and driven photographer. When Mori and his former lover, Asako, reunite by chance and catch up, they confront different versions of the past within their own recalled memories. After they part ways, Asako comes home to a warm meal lovingly prepared by her partner, and a rekindled desire to paint again. At the same time, Mori visits Maiko’s exhibition, and discovers scenes of his own daily life, captured within her affectionate frames.
synopsis_en: A love story that interweaves past and present, depicting the current state of a drifting married couple and a reunion with a friend that stirs up past memories. This is the feature-length directorial debut of Daisuke Shigayuki, who gained attention for short films like "Haru Mitai da" and "Madotachi," completed after a seven-year production period. Mori, a musician, is troubled by the distance he feels from his wife Maiko, a photographer. One day, Mori unexpectedly reunites with a former friend, Asako, rekindling old feelings for her. Asako also remembers being attracted to Mori in the past. However, their memories, tinged with expectations and desires, appear blurry, distorted, and conveniently rewritten in each of their minds. After a long walk, Mori and Asako reexamine their two lives that have already gone off track and the present moment they each stand in. Actor Soma Fujii, who also works as singer-songwriter "soma," stars as Mori and also handles the music. Ran Taniguchi (from "Hold Your Breath") plays Mori's wife Maiko, and Yukiho Murakami (from "August My Heaven") plays Mori's former friend Asako. The film was selected for the competition section of the 30th Busan International Film Festival in 2025.

movie_title: エレファント６レコーディング・カンパニー
movie_title_en: A Future History Of: The Elephant 6 Recording Co.
director: チャド・ストックフレス
synopsis: . “DIY”で音楽を創造し続けた＜エレファント６＞とはいったい何者なのか。変わり者の集まりに見えて、ただひたすらに純粋で創造性が爆発していた彼らの活動の裏側を紐解いていく― . 1980年代後半にルイジアナ州ラストンで誕生した＜エレファント6＞。高校時代からの仲間であるビル・ドス、ウィル・カレン・ハート、ジェフ・マンガム、ロバート・シュナイダーらが自宅に集合しては手あたり次第に手に入れた楽器や機材を使って“実験”をはじめる――サイケデリック音楽に影響を受け、共通の感性を持つ彼らはコロラド州デンバーやジョージア州アセンズといった小さな大学都市へ移り住み、旧式の4トラックおよび8トラック録音技術が一般に普及し始めた時期とも重なった。彼らは新しい音楽世界を創造しようとさらに“実験”を重ね、後に「オリヴィア・トレマー・コントロール」、「ニュートラル・ミルク・ホテル」、「アップルズ・イン・ステレオ」といったバンドが生まれたのだ。この３つのバンドはエレファント6の基盤となり、間もなくして数多くのバンドがコレクティヴに参加した。 ロバート・シュナイダーと友人でもあるチャド・ストックフレス監督が約10年の歳月かけてカメラを回し続けた本作は、2019年に返却必須のレンタルビデオ方式のみで公開され、VHSビデオテープでしか見ることができなかった幻のタイトルであり、数多くのアーティストたちの活動の裏側を紐解いていく。関係者へのインタビューはもちろんのこと、『ロード・オブ・ザ・リング』三部作のイライジャ・ウッド、『エターナル・サンシャイン』(04)のデヴィッド・クロスなども出演し、登場人物は多岐にわたっている。家賃の安い大きな家を借りて仲間たちと暮らし、ある時は部屋にアルミホイルを貼り付けてはスタジオにするなど、彼らは常にDIYで創造することにこだわり、レコーディングを重ねていた。友情ではじまった彼らの活動は、当時主流だった音楽への反発心もあいまって支持を広げ、アメリカのミュージックシーンにかつてないムーブメントを巻き起こしたのだった。90年代とはいったい何だったのか、＜エレファント6＞がどれだけ愛されてきたのか―― これは、彼らの貴重な記録であり、未来のアーティストたちへのメッセージでもあるのだ。本国アメリカでは2022年11月にライブ映像等が追加、アップデートされた最新版が公開されるや話題を集めた。日本国内では小山田圭吾やカヒミ・カリィがメンバーと繋がっていることから当時から注目を集め、根強い人気からファンが待ち焦がれていた待望作が遂に日本で劇場公開を迎える！
synopsis_en: Who exactly are the Elephant 6 collective, who kept creating music through DIY? Unraveling the behind-the-scenes story of a group that looked like a bunch of eccentrics but were purely and explosively creative—Elephant 6 was born in Ruston, Louisiana in the late 1980s. High school friends Bill Doss, Will Cullen Hart, Jeff Mangum, and Robert Schneider would gather at home and start "experimenting" with whatever instruments and equipment they could get their hands on. Influenced by psychedelic music and sharing a common sensibility, they moved to small college towns like Denver, Colorado, and Athens, Georgia, coinciding with the period when old 4-track and 8-track recording technology was becoming widely available. They continued to "experiment" further to create a new musical world, eventually giving birth to bands like The Olivia Tremor Control, Neutral Milk Hotel, and The Apples in Stereo. These three bands became the foundation of Elephant 6, and soon many more bands joined the collective. Directed by Chad Stockfleth, a friend of Robert Schneider, who kept filming for about ten years, this film was released in 2019 only through a rental-video system that required return, and could only be seen on VHS tapes—a legendary title that unravels the behind-the-scenes activities of numerous artists. In addition to interviews with those involved, Elijah Wood of "The Lord of the Rings" trilogy and David Cross of "Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind" (2004) also appear, among a wide range of figures. They lived together in large, cheap-rent houses, sometimes lining rooms with aluminum foil to make studios, always committed to creating through DIY and recording. What began as friendship, combined with a backlash against the mainstream music of the time, gained support and sparked an unprecedented movement in the American music scene. What was the 90s really about, and how much was Elephant 6 loved? This is both a precious record of them and a message to future artists. In the US, an updated version with added live footage and more was released in November 2022 and generated buzz. In Japan, the collective drew attention from the start due to connections with Keigo Oyamada and Kahimi Karie, and now the long-awaited film that fans have been eagerly anticipating finally hits Japanese theaters! The poster visual and Japanese trailer have been unveiled. The poster features Robert Schneider of The Apples in Stereo, the pioneering and central band of Elephant 6, Bill Doss and Will Cullen Hart of The Olivia Tremor Control, Jeff Mangum of Neutral Milk Hotel, along with many other unique bands and artists—the "friends" of the collective, including Of Montreal, Elf Power, and The Music Tapes. The visual conveys their otherworldly atmosphere and unpretentious charm as they lived together in big houses and kept creating music in DIY style. The trailer, set to "Tidal Wave" by The Apples in Stereo and "In The Aeroplane Over The Sea" by Neutral Milk Hotel, cuts together interviews and precious live footage, with appearances by Elijah Wood and David Cross. As Jeff Mangum's words—"Making music together is fun"—symbolize, there was no right or wrong; they simply kept creating the music they loved with their friends. The film conveys how countless artists influenced one another.
movie_title_jp: エレファント６レコーディング・カンパニー
director_jp: チャド・ストックフレス

country: 日本・フランス合作
synopsis: 「息を殺して」「泳ぎすぎた夜」で国際的にも注目を集めている俊英・五十嵐耕平監督が、海辺の町を舞台に忘れることのできない大切な時間を描いた、ひと夏の物語。 2023年8月19日、伊豆にある海辺のリゾートホテルを訪れた幼なじみの佐野と宮田。そのホテルはまもなく閉館することになっており、アンをはじめとしたベトナム人の従業員たちは、ひと足早く退職日を迎えようとしている。佐野は、5年前にここで出会って恋に落ち、結婚した妻の凪を最近亡くしたばかり。妻との思い出に固執し、自暴自棄になる佐野の様子を見かねた宮田は、友人として助言をするものの、その言葉は佐野には届かない。2人は少ない言葉を交わしながら思い出の場所を巡り、5年前に凪が失くした赤い帽子を探すが……。 佐野役を「TOCKA タスカー」の佐野弘樹、宮田役を濱口竜介監督の「悪は存在しない」にも出演した宮田佳典、凪役を今泉力哉監督の「猫は逃げた」に主演して注目された山本奈衣瑠がそれぞれ演じた。「泳ぎすぎた夜」で共同監督を務めたダミアン・マニベルがプロデューサーとして参加し、日仏合作映画として製作された。第81回ベネチア国際映画祭ベニス・デイズ部門のオープニング作品に選出。
tmdb_overview_jp: 2023年8月19日、伊豆にある海辺のリゾートホテルを訪れた佐野と宮田。佐野は、5年前にここで出会い恋に落ちた妻・凪を最近亡くしたばかりだった。妻との思い出に固執し自暴自棄になる姿を見かねて、宮田は友人として助言をするものの、あるセミナーに傾倒している宮田の言葉は佐野には届かない。2人は少ない言葉を交わしながら、閉店した思い出のレストランや遊覧船を巡り、かつて失くした赤い帽子を探し始める。
tmdb_overview_en: Accompanied by his friend Miyata, Sano returns to Izu, a seaside resort in Japan where five years before he fell in love with his wife Nagi.
synopsis_en: On August 19, 2023, Sano and Miyata visit a seaside resort hotel in Izu. Sano had recently lost his wife Nagi, whom he had met and fallen in love with there five years earlier. Miyata, as a friend, tries to advise Sano, who is clinging to memories of his wife and becoming self-destructive, but Miyata's words, steeped in a certain seminar he is devoted to, do not reach Sano. Exchanging few words, the two visit the now-closed restaurant and sightseeing boat filled with memories, and begin searching for the red hat that was lost long ago.

country: 日本
synopsis: 染谷将太が主演を務め、コンビニを舞台に描くホラー作品。コンビニというルーティン化された社会の中で起こった小さな歪みをきっかけに、外の世界も終わりに向かっていく姿を描く。第76回ベルリン国際映画祭フォーラム部門に出品され、国際映画批評家連盟賞を受賞した。 東京の片隅にあるコンビニ、エニーマート倉冨町7丁目店の副店長・堺は、学生時代に働き始めて以来、気づけば20代のほとんどをこの店で過ごしてきた。レジ打ちに品出し、廃棄処理。そしてスマホゲームにマッチングアプリ。毎日はただ同じことを繰り返して過ぎていく。オーナーはコンビニというシステムの中でわずかな乱れも許さず店を支配しているが、そこへ新人アルバイトの小河が現れたことで、店の均衡は静かに崩れ始めていく。 ショートフィルム集「NN4444」や中編ホラー「〇〇式」を手がけて注目を集める映画レーベル「NOTHING NEW」が初めて送り出した長編作品。監督は、「NN4444」にも収められた短編「VOID」を手がけ、これが初長編作品となった岩崎裕介。主人公のコンビニ副店長・堺を染谷が演じ、新人アルバイト・小河役を唐田えりか、オーナー役を西村まさ彦、コンビニ店員・室井役をお笑いコンビ「令和ロマン」のくるまが務めた。
tmdb_overview_en: A supermarket as both a microcosm of Japanese society and the setting for a socially critical horror film. Expressionless faces and a supervisor who demands zombie-like friendliness. Only the young Sakai doesn’t stop hoping.
synopsis_en: At a convenience store called AnyMart in a corner of Tokyo, the assistant manager Sakai (Sosuke Ikematsu) has spent most of his twenties working there since his student days. Register work. Stocking shelves. Disposal. Mobile games. Dating apps. Just repeating the same things every day. The owner (Masahiko Nishimura) rules the store within the convenience store system, allowing no deviation. However, the arrival of a new part-time worker, Ogawa (Erika Karata), begins to quietly disrupt the store's equilibrium. Eventually, this distortion silently and surely transforms the convenience store into an extreme space.

synopsis: 世代の異なる人々がそれぞれに抱える「喪失」をテーマに、3つの物語をつづったオムニバスドラマ。 過去に恋人を失った男と心に傷を抱えた女性が出会い、近づくほどにすれ違っていく第1話「さよならロストフォリア」、“願いがかなう”と噂される存在を探す女子高生たちが、本当にかなえたかった願いと向き合う第2話「ケサランパサランのつかまえ方」、古本屋を営む兄のもとへ突然帰省した妹と地元の幼なじみが、人生の岐路で過去と向き合う一夜を描く第3話「青い鳥は待ちわびて」の3話で構成。10代、20代、40代という異なる世代が向き合う喪失を描いた。 第1話に篠田諒と山本亜依、第2話に葵うたのと渋江譲二、第3話に谷口賢志と佐津川愛美が出演。監督・脚本の大倉寛之は、平日は会社員として働くかたわら映像制作を続け、2020年に初監督作となる短編映画を完成させた。本作が初の劇場公開作品となる。
synopsis_en: An omnibus work depicting 'hearts carrying loss'. The title 'Lostphoria' is a coined term that regards 'loss (Lost)' as a state of mind. Through protagonists of different generations, this film portrays the loneliness and pain that everyone harbors, and the 'faint light' that lies beyond them. It was created with the aim of allowing audiences to touch the loneliness of others and feel that 'they are not alone'.

cinema_name: シネマブルースタジオ
director: クロード・オータン＝ララ
country: フランス 原題または英題：Le rouge et le noir
synopsis: フランスの文豪スタンダールの代表作を、「肉体の悪魔」のクロード・オータン＝ララ監督＆ジェラール・フィリップ主演のコンビで映画化。ナポレオン失脚後の1820年代フランスを舞台に、野心家の青年が自身の魅力を武器に貴族階級へ転身を図ろうとする姿を描き出す。 フランスの小都市ベリエール。大工の息子ジュリアン・ソレルは学問が得意で、シェラン司祭にその才覚を認められ、町長を務めるレナル家の家庭教師となる。やがてジュリアンはレナル夫人と恋に落ちるが、スキャンダルの発覚を恐れて神学校へ進むことに。そこでピラール司教の信頼を得たジュリアンは、パリのラモール侯爵の秘書として働き始め、侯爵令嬢マチルドと愛し合うようになるが……。 「うたかたの恋」「ロシュフォールの恋人たち」のダニエル・ダリューがレナル夫人、「狂った夜」のアントネッラ・ルアルディがマチルドを演じた。
synopsis_en: This film adaptation of French literary giant Stendhal's masterpiece was directed by Claude Autant-Lara, known for "The Devil in the Flesh," and stars Gérard Philipe. Set in 1820s France after Napoleon's fall, it portrays an ambitious young man who uses his charm to try to climb into the aristocratic class. In the small French town of Verrières, Julien Sorel, a carpenter's son, excels in academics and is recognized by Abbé Chélan for his talent, becoming the tutor for the mayor's family, the Rênals. Julien soon falls in love with Madame de Rênal, but fearing scandal, he moves on to a seminary. There, he gains the trust of Abbé Pirard and begins working as secretary to the Marquis de la Môle in Paris, where he falls in love with the Marquis's daughter, Mathilde... Danièle Delorme, of "The Eternal Return" and "The Lovers of Rochefort," plays Madame de Rênal, and Antonella Lualdi, of "Crazy Night," plays Mathilde.
director_jp: クロード・オータン＝ララ

movie_title_en: The Girl with the Hat Box
country: ソ連 原題または英題：Dievouchshka s Korobkoi The Girl with a Hatbox
program_title: ソヴィエト映画の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: サイレントならではの軽やかでコミカルな動きが画面いっぱいに広がる、初期バルネットのキュートなコメディ。 帽子作りのナターシャは、モスクワの帽子店に帽子を卸している。ある時、帽子店へ行く列車の中で貧しい学生イリヤと出会い、彼がモスクワで住む部屋を確保してあげるため偽装結婚する。ある日、帽子店の亭主に代金のかわりに渡された宝くじが当たったことで、さあ大変！その男がくじを奪回しようと血眼になり、さらにイリヤとの恋の行方もからんで、ナターシャをめぐる大騒動が巻き起こる。
tmdb_overview_en: A Moscow hat shop girl chances upon a penniless young man who has arrived from the countryside for university and takes pity on him.
synopsis_en: A cute comedy from early Barnet featuring light and comical movements that fill the screen, a hallmark of silent films. Natasha, a hat maker, supplies hats to a shop in Moscow. One day, on a train to the hat shop, she meets a poor student named Ilya and enters into a fake marriage to secure him a place to live in Moscow. One day, a lottery ticket given to her by the shop owner instead of payment turns out to be a winner, and chaos ensues! The man becomes desperate to reclaim the ticket, and with the course of her romance with Ilya also in the mix, a great commotion erupts around Natasha.

synopsis: 東映動画初のSF長篇。黒田昌郎が単独で演出した最初の長篇でもあり、デザイン性の高い画面構成やミュージカル調の作風が、寓話性を帯びた世界観を際立たせる。メタ映画的な構造を取り入れる野心的な試みもなされ、東映動画における新世代の躍進を思わせる一作となった。ラストに明かされる王女の秘密には文明批判の意図が滲むが、これは動画スタッフだった宮崎駿の発案による。
tmdb_overview_jp: 両親も住む家もない、貧しいが多くの夢を持つ少年のテッド。ある日科学者のガリバー博士と出会った彼は、博士と一緒にロケット「ガリバー号」に乗って宇宙探索へ行くことに!?希望の星を目指して旅する2人だったが、やっとたどりついた星には希望がなく…。
tmdb_overview_en: The story concerns a homeless boy named Ted. After seeing a movie about Gulliver he meets Professor Gulliver himself in a forest. Gulliver is now an elderly, space-traveling scientist. With Dr. Gulliver's assistant Crow, and Ted's companions, a talking dog and a toy soldier, they travel the Milky Way to the Planet of Blue Hope, which has been taken over by the Queen of Purple Planet and her evil group of robots. Armed with water-pistols and water balloons, which melt the villains, Ricky and Gulliver restore Blue Hope to its doll-like owners.
genres: サイエンスフィクション
synopsis_en: Toei Animation's first sci-fi feature. It is also the first feature-length film solely directed by Kuroda Yoshiro, whose highly designed compositions and musical style highlight the allegorical world. Ambitious meta-cinematic structures are employed, marking a breakthrough for a new generation at Toei Animation. The princess's secret revealed at the end carries a critique of civilization, an idea proposed by then-animator Hayao Miyazaki.

synopsis: 「私の一生は一篇の童話であった」というアンデルセンの言葉から着想を得た音楽劇で、「赤い靴」や「親指姫」などの童話を織り交ぜながらアンデルセンの少年時代を描く。夜空には色とりどりの星が輝き、オーケストラの音色が物語を包む。小山礼司の美術と宇野誠一郎の音楽が、メルヘンの世界を甘美に表現している。
tmdb_overview_jp: 童話作家になるのが夢のハンス少年のもとに、眠りの精オーレおじさん（Ole）がやってくる。アンデルセン童話の有名な「マッチ売りの少女」や、「親指姫」、「赤い靴」などのエピソードを織り交ぜて、ミュージカル仕立てのストーリーは展開する。
tmdb_overview_en: During his boyhood, young Hans Christian Andersen is exposed to the musical fairy-tale dream world by his Uncle Ole.
movie_title_en: The World of Hans Christian Andersen
synopsis_en: Inspired by Hans Christian Andersen's words, 'My life is a fairy tale,' this musical drama weaves together tales like 'The Red Shoes' and 'Thumbelina' while depicting Andersen's boyhood. The night sky sparkles with colorful stars, and the orchestra's melodies envelop the story. The art by Reiji Koyama and the music by Seiichiro Uno sweetly bring this fairy-tale world to life.

movie_title_en: Little Amélie or the Character of Rain
country: フランス
tmdb_overview_jp: 1960年代神戸—日本で生まれたベルギー人の小さな女の子アメリ。彼女の成長を描く物語。外交官の家庭に生まれ、2歳半までは無反応状態だったアメリ。その後、子ども時代に突入した彼女は自らを「神」だと信じ、魔法のような世界を生きている。家政婦のニシオさんや家族との日々の生活は、彼女にとって冒険であり、新たな発見の連続。少しずつ変化していくアメリ。しかし、3歳の誕生日に人生を変える出来事が起こり、彼女の世界は大きく変わっていく…。誰もが子供時代に夢見た世界を描く感動のアニメーション作品
tmdb_overview_en: The world is a perplexing, peaceful mystery to Amélie until a miraculous encounter with chocolate ignites her wild sense of curiosity. As she develops a deep attachment to her family's housekeeper, Nishio-san, Amélie discovers the wonders of nature as well as the emotional truths hidden beneath the surface of her family's idyllic life as foreigners in post-war Japan.
movie_title_original: Amélie et la métaphysique des tubes
synopsis_en: An animated film set in 1960s Kobe, depicting the growth of Amélie, a Belgian girl born in Japan. Based on the autobiographical novel "Tube Metaphysics" by Belgian writer Amélie Nothomb, it portrays a world rich in emotion, seen through the eyes of the two-year-old protagonist Amélie, woven with life, color, and her witty words. In 1960s Kobe, Amélie, a Belgian girl born into a diplomat's family, is unresponsive until age two and a half, but then enters an invincible childhood, believing herself to be a god and living in a magical world. Her days with her beloved housekeeper Nishio and her family are adventures full of new discoveries. One day, she learns the kanji for "rain," which suits her perfectly. Then, on her third birthday, an event occurs that changes everything. Directed by Myriam Ballard and Liang-Cho Han, who worked on "Long Way North," with music by Japanese composer Mari Fukuhara. It won the Audience Award at the 2025 Annecy International Animated Film Festival and was nominated for Best Animated Feature at the 98th Academy Awards.

movie_title: 新感染 ファイナル・エクスプレス 4K
country: 韓国
tmdb_overview_jp: 『釜山行き』は、正体不明のウイルスが韓国全土に拡散して緊急警報が発令された中、汚染されずに残ったたったひとつの安全都市“釜山（プサン）”を目指して釜山行きの列車に乗り込んだ人々が、生き残るために熾烈な死闘を繰り広げるパニック大作。人間の欲が招く災いと、それぞれが生き延びるために選択した方法から暴かれる人間の本性を描く。
tmdb_overview_en: When a zombie virus pushes Korea into a state of emergency, those trapped on an express train to Busan must fight for their own survival.
clean_title_jp: 新感染 ファイナル・エクスプレス
movie_title_jp: 新感染 ファイナル・エクスプレス
synopsis_en: A Korean survival panic action film depicting the terror and chaos caused by the sudden outbreak of a mysterious virus spreading aboard a high-speed train connecting Seoul and Busan. Seok-woo, a fund manager working in Seoul, is separated from his wife and lives with his young daughter Su-an. Su-an insists on going alone to meet her mother in Busan for her birthday, and Seok-woo reluctantly agrees to escort her. They board the KTX high-speed train from Seoul to Busan, but just before departure, a suspicious commotion occurs near Seoul Station. A woman infected with the mysterious virus also boards KTX train 101, the same train as the father and daughter. Alongside the protagonist Seok-woo and his daughter, various passengers—a pregnant woman and her husband, high school baseball players, and a selfish middle-aged businessman—face a life-or-death struggle for survival in a state of extremity where being caught by the infected means certain death, and their individual human dramas unfold. This is the first live-action feature film by Yeon Sang-ho, a rising director who has garnered attention in the Korean animation scene, and the story preceding this film is revealed in the animated feature 'Seoul Station'.

movie_title: バルタザールどこへ行く 4Kレストア
director: ロベール・ブレッソン
country: フランス・スウェーデン
tmdb_overview_jp: ピレネーの小村。教師の娘マリーは農園主の息子ジャックと共に、生まれたばかりのロバに“バルタザール”と名前をつけ可愛がる。ある日ジャックが引っ越すことになり、バルタザールもどこかへ行ってしまう。10年後、バルタザールが再び現れ、マリーが喜んであちこち“彼”に馬車を引かせ出かけるのを見て、彼女に思慕を寄せる不良のジェラールは嫉妬し、バルタザールを痛めつけ、実家のパン屋の仕事にこき使う・・・。
tmdb_overview_en: The story of a donkey Balthazar as he is passed from owner to owner, some kind and some cruel but all with motivations beyond his understanding. Balthazar, whose life parallels that of his first keeper, Marie, is truly a beast of burden, suffering the sins of humankind. But despite his powerlessness, he accepts his fate nobly.
clean_title_jp: バルタザールどこへ行く
movie_title_jp: バルタザールどこへ行く
director_jp: ロベール・ブレッソン
synopsis_en: The 7th feature film by master director Robert Bresson, known for "L'Argent," "Pickpocket," and "The Trial of Joan of Arc," released in 1966. Inspired by an episode from Dostoevsky's novel "The Idiot," it portrays the strange fate of a donkey and a young girl. In a small Pyrenean village, little Marie names a newborn donkey Balthazar and cherishes him. Ten years later, Balthazar is used for hard labor by a blacksmith but escapes the suffering and returns to Marie. The grown Marie rejoices at their reunion and takes Balthazar with her, but Gérard, who has feelings for her, becomes jealous and torments the donkey. Through the silent perspective of the donkey, the film calmly depicts human folly and ugliness, winning the Special Jury Prize at the Venice International Film Festival and earning acclaim as a masterpiece. Starring Anne Wiazemsky, who later appeared in many Godard films including "La Chinoise," in her film debut. First theatrically released in Japan in 1970, and again in 1995 distributed by France Eigasha. Revived in October 2020 in a 4K restored digital remaster. Also revived in 2026 as part of "Robert Bresson Masterpiece Selection."

movie_title: 少女ムシェット 4Kレストア
director: ロベール・ブレッソン
country: フランス
tmdb_overview_jp: 14歳のムシェット。家庭の貧困と父の暴力と、同級生の豊かさと美しさ、そして土曜の午後のカンタータの練習に痛めつけられる少女。森番の洩らす秘密を知って、約束を守ると誓ったのに犯されてしまう無垢な肉体。しかし、その秘密すらただの幻影に過ぎなかったと分かって、少女は完全な孤立を味わう。そんな彼女に残された選択は……。ブレッソンが、「田舎司祭の日記」の原作者G・ベルナノスの小説を、自ら脚色して映画化。
tmdb_overview_en: A young girl living in the French countryside suffers constant indignities at the hand of alcoholism and her fellow man.
director_jp: ロベール・ブレッソン
synopsis_en: Master filmmaker Robert Bresson's eighth feature, made right after his masterpiece "Au Hasard Balthazar." Based on a novel by French author Georges Bernanos, it starkly and realistically depicts the tragic fate of a young girl through rigorous framing and the actors' minimally restrained performances. 14-year-old Mouchette lives in the French countryside, forced to run the household for her alcoholic father and ill mother, while being cruelly treated by classmates and teachers at school. The unfortunate girl's fate takes a turn for the worse when, one rainy night, she encounters a poacher in the forest, sending her spiraling into further misery and ruin. Nadine Nortier, discovered for this role, plays the protagonist Mouchette, a girl standing on the brink of despair yet harboring a rebellious spirit. Produced in 1967, it was first released in Japan in 1974 by Equipe de Cinema, and again in 1995 by France Eiga Sha. A 4K restored digital remastered version had a revival release in October 2020. Another revival release is scheduled for 2026 as part of the "Robert Bresson Masterpiece Selection."

director: ロベール・ブレッソン
country: フランス
tmdb_overview_jp: 貧しい大学生ミシェルは、ふとしたきっかけで、自分にスリの才能があることを発見する。一度は刑事に捕まったものの、証拠不十分で釈放されるや、再び他人の財布を狙い出す。やがてその手口は、仲間を引き込んだ組織的なものになっていった……。「抵抗」では“脱獄”をリアルにスリリングに描いたＲ・ブレッソンが、今度はその焦点を“スリ”に当てた作品で、実際の手口を紹介しながら、人間不信の孤独な青年の姿を描く。素人ばかりの出演者から生まれるリアリティと、様々なスリの描写によって生み出されるサスペンスが混然となった迫真の傑作だ。
tmdb_overview_en: Michel takes up pickpocketing on a lark and is arrested soon after. His mother dies shortly after his release, and despite the objections of his only friend, Jacques, and his mother's neighbor Jeanne, Michel teams up with a couple of petty thieves in order to improve his craft. With a police inspector keeping an eye on him, Michel also tries to get a straight job, but the temptation to steal is hard to resist.
director_jp: ロベール・ブレッソン
synopsis_en: Michel, a poor university student, discovers by chance that he has a talent for pickpocketing. Though once caught by a detective, he is released due to lack of evidence and soon targets others' wallets again. Eventually, his methods become organized as he brings in accomplices. In 'A Man Escaped,' Bresson realistically and thrillingly depicted a prison break; here, he turns his focus to pickpocketing, introducing actual techniques while portraying a lonely young man distrustful of others. A gripping masterpiece where the realism born from amateur actors and the suspense created by various pickpocketing scenes blend seamlessly.

director: ロベール・ブレッソン
country: フランス・スイス
tmdb_overview_jp: 「抵抗（レジスタンス）　死刑囚の手記より」「少女ムシェット」などの名作を残したフランスの名匠ロベール・ブレッソン監督が、ロシアの文豪トルストイの原作をもとに、偶然手にしてしまったニセ札を知らずに使ってしまったことから、一家惨殺事件を引き起こし転落していく人生を歩む青年イボンの姿を描いた。
tmdb_overview_en: A forged 500-franc note is passed from person to person and shop to shop, until it falls into the hands of a genuine innocent who doesn't see it for what it is—which will have devastating consequences on his life.
director_jp: ロベール・ブレッソン
synopsis_en: The 13th feature film by French master director Robert Bresson, who left behind masterpieces such as "Resistance: From the Prisoner's Diary" and "Mouchette." Bresson, already over 80 at the time of filming, passed away in 1999, making this his final work. Based on the novella "The Forged Coupon" by Russian literary giant Leo Tolstoy, it depicts the life of Yvon, a young fuel delivery man who, after unknowingly using a counterfeit bill that falls into his hands, triggers a family massacre and spirals downward. The title "L'argent" means "money" in French. First released in Japan in 1986. Revived in 2011 as part of "Cinema Masterpiece Selection III: The Art of Robert Bresson" with new prints. In 2026, it will be revived again in a 2K restored version as part of "Robert Bresson Masterpiece Selection."

director: ロベール・ブレッソン
country: フランス・イタリア
tmdb_overview_jp: 画家の卵であるジャックはある夜、セーヌに身投げしようとする少女マルトを助ける。彼女には一年前アメリカ留学に発った恋人がおり、二人が再会を約束したのがその晩だったのだ。青年は苦悶に沈む彼女を美しいと思った。そして、激しい愛の衝動につき動かされながら、努めて平静を装い、彼女の心が恋人から離れるのを望み、そこに罪悪感を覚える。'５７年版と同じく、有名なドストエフスキーの悲恋小説を現代を舞台に翻案した、ブレッソンの覚醒した世界観を窺わす痛烈な作品だ。ヴィスコンティのロマンチズムはここになく、青年の盲愛が、彼の習性である思いのたけをミニ・テレコに吹き込むという形で、露骨に顕わになる様が見ていく苦しいほどだ。 ＜allcinema＞
tmdb_overview_en: Jacques, a young man with artistic aspirations, spends four nights wandering Paris with a young woman, whom he rescued from suicide.
director_jp: ロベール・ブレッソン
synopsis_en: Jacques, an aspiring painter, saves a young woman named Marthe from throwing herself into the Seine one night. She had a lover who left for America a year ago, and that very night was when they had promised to reunite. Jacques finds her, sunk in anguish, beautiful. Driven by a fierce impulse of love, he forces himself to remain calm, hoping her heart will drift away from her lover, while feeling guilt over this. Like the 1957 version, this is a modern adaptation of Dostoevsky's famous tragic love story, a poignant work revealing Bresson's awakened worldview. Visconti's romanticism is absent here; the young man's blind love is brutally exposed as he pours out his feelings into a mini tape recorder, a habit of his, making it painful to watch.

movie_title: ウィキッド 永遠の約束
country: アメリカ
tmdb_overview_en: As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, Glinda and Elphaba will need to come together one final time. With their singular friendship now the fulcrum of their futures, they will need to truly see each other, with honesty and empathy, if they are to change themselves, and all of Oz, for good.
clean_title_jp: ウィキッド 永遠の約束
movie_title_jp: ウィキッド 永遠の約束
synopsis_en: Having learned the truth hidden in the land of Oz and walked their separate paths, two witches once again face their irreplaceable former friend. The second part of the timeless musical.

synopsis: かいせつ 平安時代、親と引き離された厨子王と安寿は、奴隷として売られてしまう―。中世の説話をもとにした鷗外の短編の映画化で、ヴェネチア国際映画祭で銀獅子賞に輝いた不朽の名作。名キャメラマン・宮川がとらえた映像美にも感服。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 森鴎外の同名小説を、八尋不二と依田義賢が共同で脚色し、溝口健二がメガホンをとった文芸作品。特に美術と撮影はレベルが高く、ヴェネチア国際映画祭で銀獅子賞を受賞した。美しいラストシーンは、ゴダールが「気狂いピエロ」において引用したことでも知られる。 　平安時代末期、農民を救うため将軍にたてついた平正氏が左遷された。妻の玉木、娘の安寿と息子の厨子王は越後を旅している途中、人買いにだまされ離ればなれになってしまう。玉木は佐渡に、安寿と厨子王は丹後の山椒大夫に奴隷として売られた。きょうだいはそれから十年もの間、奴隷としての生活を続けるが、ついに意を決して逃げ出すことにする。しかし追っ手に迫られ、安寿は厨子王を逃すため池に身を投げるのだった。
tmdb_overview_en: In 11th-century feudal Japan, following the exile of an idealistic governor, his wife and children are separated by slave traders; the children, Zushio and Anju, are sold into brutal servitude under the cruel bailiff Sansho.
synopsis_en: Commentary: In the Heian period, Zushio and Anju, separated from their parents, are sold into slavery... A film adaptation of Ogai's short story based on a medieval folktale, this timeless masterpiece won the Silver Lion at the Venice International Film Festival. The visual beauty captured by the renowned cinematographer Miyagawa is also awe-inspiring.

synopsis: かいせつ 古寺の山門に立つ老街娼(田中)は、自らの流転の人生を回想していた…。家筋も良く御所勤めの経験もある娘が、いかにして身を落としたのか―。溝口・田中コンビの最高傑作との呼び声も高く、ヴェネチア映画祭で国際賞を受賞した。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 奈良の荒れ寺に集まる街娼たち。年老いたお春は羅漢堂に入り、過去に出会った男の面影を思い浮かべていた。御所勤めをしていた13歳のお春は、公卿の勝之介に宿に連れ込まれたところを見つかり、両親ともども洛外へ追放となってしまった。その後、松平家に取り立てられ嗣子をもうけたものの、側近の裏切りに遭い実家へ帰されてしまう。島原の郭に売られたお春は、気に入られた客の住み込み女中となるが、その妻に嫉妬され追い出されてしまった。さらに結婚相手が急死し、世話になった男の盗みが発覚して捕らえられるなど、流転の人生を歩むのだった。
tmdb_overview_en: During the Edo Period, a noblewoman's banishment for her love affair with a lowly page signals the beginning of her inexorable fall.
synopsis_en: Commentary: An old street prostitute (Tanaka) standing at the gate of an ancient temple recalls her tumultuous life... How did a girl from a good family with experience serving at the imperial court fall so low? Hailed as the greatest masterpiece of the Mizoguchi-Tanaka partnership, it won an international award at the Venice Film Festival.

synopsis: かいせつ 戦乱の世、欲望に駆られた男たちは、女たちを犠牲にしてまで幻影を追い求め…。怪異譚の古典を原作に、欲に惑う人間の愚かさを、現実と幻想の間に映し出す名作。ヴェネチア映画祭銀獅子賞に輝き、溝口の名を世界に轟かせた。
program_title: 没後70年 映画監督・溝口健二の世界
tmdb_overview_jp: 戦国の世、貧しい陶工・源十郎が若狭姫という女性と知り合い、生活をともにするようになる。だが美しい若狭姫の正体は死霊であった。それを知った源十郎は若狭姫を捨てて故郷に逃げるが、彼女の怨念は執拗に追いすがる……。「雨月物語」をベースに、川口松太郎らが脚色。
tmdb_overview_en: In 16th century Japan, peasants Genjuro and Tobei sell their earthenware pots to a group of soldiers in a nearby village, in defiance of a local sage's warning against seeking to profit from warfare. Genjuro's pursuit of both riches and the mysterious Lady Wakasa, as well as Tobei's desire to become a samurai, run the risk of destroying both themselves and their wives, Miyagi and Ohama.
synopsis_en: Commentary: In an age of war, men driven by lust chase illusions even at the cost of sacrificing women... Based on a classic tale of the supernatural, this masterpiece reflects the folly of humans deluded by desire, suspended between reality and fantasy. Winner of the Silver Lion at the Venice Film Festival, it spread Mizoguchi's name worldwide.

cinema_name: シネマブルースタジオ
director: クロード・オータン＝ララ
country: フランス 原題または英題：Le rouge et le noir
synopsis: フランスの文豪スタンダールの代表作を、「肉体の悪魔」のクロード・オータン＝ララ監督＆ジェラール・フィリップ主演のコンビで映画化。ナポレオン失脚後の1820年代フランスを舞台に、野心家の青年が自身の魅力を武器に貴族階級へ転身を図ろうとする姿を描き出す。 フランスの小都市ベリエール。大工の息子ジュリアン・ソレルは学問が得意で、シェラン司祭にその才覚を認められ、町長を務めるレナル家の家庭教師となる。やがてジュリアンはレナル夫人と恋に落ちるが、スキャンダルの発覚を恐れて神学校へ進むことに。そこでピラール司教の信頼を得たジュリアンは、パリのラモール侯爵の秘書として働き始め、侯爵令嬢マチルドと愛し合うようになるが……。 「うたかたの恋」「ロシュフォールの恋人たち」のダニエル・ダリューがレナル夫人、「狂った夜」のアントネッラ・ルアルディがマチルドを演じた。
synopsis_en: This film adaptation of French literary giant Stendhal's masterpiece was directed by Claude Autant-Lara, known for "The Devil in the Flesh," and stars Gérard Philipe. Set in 1820s France after Napoleon's fall, it portrays an ambitious young man who uses his charm to try to climb into the aristocratic class. In the small French town of Verrières, Julien Sorel, a carpenter's son, excels in academics and is recognized by Abbé Chélan for his talent, becoming the tutor for the mayor's family, the Rênals. Julien soon falls in love with Madame de Rênal, but fearing scandal, he moves on to a seminary. There, he gains the trust of Abbé Pirard and begins working as secretary to the Marquis de la Môle in Paris, where he falls in love with the Marquis's daughter, Mathilde... Danièle Delorme, of "The Eternal Return" and "The Lovers of Rochefort," plays Madame de Rênal, and Antonella Lualdi, of "Crazy Night," plays Mathilde.
director_jp: クロード・オータン＝ララ

tmdb_overview_en: A dramatized account of a great Russian naval mutiny and a resultant public demonstration, showing support, which brought on a police massacre.
director_jp: セルゲーイ・ミハーイロヴィチ・エイゼンシュテーイン
synopsis_en: Sailors reach the peak of their discontent with the imperial regime and rise up in rebellion. This soon escalates into a massive massacre of the populace by the military. The 'Odessa Steps' scene, where a baby carriage tumbles down the stairs, is too famous to ignore in this masterpiece by the giant of cinema, Sergei M. Eisenstein.

country: イタリア
synopsis_en: This is the feature debut of 2003 by Michelangelo Frammartino, a solitary and distinctive filmmaker in Italian cinema. Starring the director's grandfather, Angelo Frammartino, it quietly depicts the final days of an old man's life with unique humor, set in a small Calabrian village on the verge of abandonment due to depopulation. An old man lives in a depopulating rural village in southern Italy. One day, young men who help him bury his old dog leave behind a cell phone and a scrap of paper—a nude photo taken for personal purposes. Later, the old man notices a woman in the village; she is the person in the photo. Using no professional actors, filming with local residents, the film creates a quiet visual poem exploring universal themes of "tradition and modernity," "life and death," and "community and solitude." It will have its Japanese theatrical premiere in 2026 in a 4K restored version as part of the special screening series "The Amazing World of Michelangelo Frammartino."

director: ミケランジェロ・フランマルティーノ
country: イタリア
tmdb_overview_en: An old shepherd lives his last days in a quiet medieval village perched high on the hills of Calabria, at the southernmost tip of Italy. He herds goats under skies that most villagers have deserted long ago. He is sick, and believes to find his medicine in the dust he collects on the church floor, which he drinks in his water every day.
director_jp: ミケランジェロ・フランマルティーノ
synopsis_en: Italian filmmaker Michelangelo Frammartino tells the story of four lives that are born and die. Based on the Pythagorean concept of "four transmigrations," the film presents humans, animals, plants, and minerals with equal weight from a fundamentally egalitarian perspective that does not center the human world. After an elderly shepherd quietly dies in a mountain village in Calabria, southern Italy, his young goat dies beside a large fir tree. The tree is cut down for a village festival and eventually becomes charcoal. With no dialogue and long takes, the film captures nature as it is. In Japan, it screened in the natural TIFF section of the 23rd Tokyo International Film Festival in 2010 and was released theatrically in 2011. It will be released in 2026 as part of the special screening series "The Amazing World of Michelangelo Frammartino."

director: ミケランジェロ・フランマルティーノ
country: イタリア
tmdb_overview_en: In August 1961, speleologists from Italy’s booming North arrive on a Calabrian plateau where time stands still. The intruders discover one of the world’s deepest caves, the Bifurto Abyss, under the gaze of an old shepherd, the only witness of the pristine territory.
director_jp: ミケランジェロ・フランマルティーノ
synopsis_en: Director Michelangelo Frammartino, whose "Four Lives" depicting the cycle of life earned high praise at the Cannes Film Festival, questions the meaning of humanity's venture into the unknown against the historical context of Italy's economic boom. This film won the Special Jury Prize in the Competition section of the 78th Venice International Film Festival in 2021. Young explorers descend 683 meters underground without maps, using acetylene lamps to measure and map the cave structure. Above ground, an elderly shepherd on the Pollino Plateau prepares for a quiet death amidst vast nature, suffering from illness. The shepherd's death coincides with the explorers reaching the deepest abyss, creating a grand cycle of life and death, time and space. The cinematographer is the renowned Renato Berta, known for collaborations with masters like Jean-Luc Godard, Éric Rohmer, Daniel Schmid, and Manoel de Oliveira. In Japan, it screened under the title "Cave" in the World Focus section of the 34th Tokyo International Film Festival. It will have its theatrical premiere in Japan in 2026 under the title "Journey to the Depths of the Earth" as part of the special screening series "The Amazing World of Michelangelo Frammartino."

country: チェコスロバキア
tmdb_overview_en: In Nazi-occupied Czechoslovakia, a doctor-turned-warehouse employee reluctantly agrees to treat a gravely wounded political fugitive, putting himself and everyone living in his building complex in danger.
synopsis_en: Set in Nazi-occupied Czechoslovakia, this drama portrays the terror of an informant society during wartime. Dr. Braun, a Jew living in Nazi-occupied Czechoslovakia, is forbidden from practicing medicine. The elderly man seems to have already accepted the fate of the Jews. Then one day, a neighbor asks him to treat a wounded political fugitive, and he reluctantly provides care. Eventually confronting his inner self, Dr. Braun decides to continue illegal treatment for the resistance to reclaim his identity. He wanders the streets of Prague in search of the morphine needed for this, but... Through the various people Dr. Braun meets and the wartime cityscape, the film depicts a society decaying and collapsing under war with hallucinatory visual beauty. In Japan, it will have its theatrical premiere in April 2026 as part of "Czech Film Masterpieces," a series featuring classics of the Czech New Wave.

country: チェコスロバキア
tmdb_overview_jp: プラハの小さな葬儀社で火葬人として働くカレル・コップフルキングルは、家族を愛する平凡な男だった。ある時、第1次世界大戦中にともに戦った戦友と再会するが、彼はナチ党の一員となっていた。友人に地元のユダヤ人社会を監視するよう説得されたカレルは、次第に友人や社会情勢に影響されていき……。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1930s Prague, a Czech cremator who firmly believes cremation relieves one from earthly suffering is drawn inexorably to Nazism.
synopsis_en: Set in Prague, Czechoslovakia on the eve of World War II, this dark comedy depicts how an ordinary citizen working at a funeral home is influenced by his pro-Nazi friend and the social climate, driving him toward a disastrous solution. Karel Kopfrkingl, who works as a cremator at a small Prague funeral home, is an ordinary man who loves his family. One day, he reunites with a war buddy from World War I, who has become a member of the Nazi Party. Persuaded by his friend to monitor the local Jewish community, Karel gradually becomes influenced by his friend and the social situation... The film portrays how an utterly ordinary person becomes a perpetrator, using beautiful yet eerie expressionistic imagery. This work, which exposes the terror of totalitarian ideology, was banned in its home country of Czechoslovakia and could not be shown until the fall of the communist regime in 1990. It won the Grand Prize at the 5th Sitges - Catalonian International Film Festival. In Japan, it will have its theatrical premiere in April 2026 as part of "Czech Film Masterpieces," a series featuring classics of the Czech New Wave.

movie_title: キラー・オブ・シープ
country: アメリカ
tmdb_overview_en: An African-American man working at a slaughterhouse in the Watts area of Los Angeles leads a dissatisfied and listless existence.
synopsis_en: The feature debut of Charles Burnett, a filmmaker who quietly revolutionized American cinema by depicting the daily lives and humanity of African Americans, released in 1977. It portrays the everyday existence of African American workers living on the fringes of Los Angeles with a realistic gaze and poetic visual beauty. Set in the Watts district of Los Angeles in the early 1970s, still bearing the scars of the Watts riots. Stan works at a sheep slaughterhouse to support his wife and two children, living an empty daily life. Exhausted physically and mentally by labor and poverty, he withdraws into himself, while his wife grows increasingly lonely. Directed by Burnett as his graduate thesis film while a student at UCLA Film School, it was shot in Watts using a mostly amateur cast of people he knew. Long unreleased due to music copyright issues, it finally had a theatrical release in the US in 2007. The 4K restoration completed in 2025 replaces the music in the final scene with Dinah Washington's "Unforgettable," as Burnett originally intended. It won the FIPRESCI Prize at the Forum section of the 31st Berlin International Film Festival in 1981. In Japan, it will have its first theatrical release in the 4K restored version as part of the special screening series "Charles Burnett: Everyday Blues" (starting February 7, 2026, at Theater Image Forum).

synopsis_en: Commentary: In an age of war, men driven by lust chase illusions even at the cost of sacrificing women... Based on a classic tale of the supernatural, this masterpiece reflects the folly of humans deluded by desire, suspended between reality and fantasy. Winner of the Silver Lion at the Venice Film Festival, it spread Mizoguchi's name worldwide.

tmdb_overview_jp: 森鴎外の同名小説を、八尋不二と依田義賢が共同で脚色し、溝口健二がメガホンをとった文芸作品。特に美術と撮影はレベルが高く、ヴェネチア国際映画祭で銀獅子賞を受賞した。美しいラストシーンは、ゴダールが「気狂いピエロ」において引用したことでも知られる。 　平安時代末期、農民を救うため将軍にたてついた平正氏が左遷された。妻の玉木、娘の安寿と息子の厨子王は越後を旅している途中、人買いにだまされ離ればなれになってしまう。玉木は佐渡に、安寿と厨子王は丹後の山椒大夫に奴隷として売られた。きょうだいはそれから十年もの間、奴隷としての生活を続けるが、ついに意を決して逃げ出すことにする。しかし追っ手に迫られ、安寿は厨子王を逃すため池に身を投げるのだった。
tmdb_overview_en: In 11th-century feudal Japan, following the exile of an idealistic governor, his wife and children are separated by slave traders; the children, Zushio and Anju, are sold into brutal servitude under the cruel bailiff Sansho.
synopsis_en: Commentary: In the Heian period, Zushio and Anju, separated from their parents, are sold into slavery... A film adaptation of Ogai's short story based on a medieval folktale, this timeless masterpiece won the Silver Lion at the Venice International Film Festival. The visual beauty captured by the renowned cinematographer Miyagawa is also awe-inspiring.

synopsis_en: The 7th feature film by master director Robert Bresson, known for "L'Argent," "Pickpocket," and "The Trial of Joan of Arc," released in 1966. Inspired by an episode from Dostoevsky's novel "The Idiot," it portrays the strange fate of a donkey and a young girl. In a small Pyrenean village, little Marie names a newborn donkey Balthazar and cherishes him. Ten years later, Balthazar is used for hard labor by a blacksmith but escapes the suffering and returns to Marie. The grown Marie rejoices at their reunion and takes Balthazar with her, but Gérard, who has feelings for her, becomes jealous and torments the donkey. Through the silent perspective of the donkey, the film calmly depicts human folly and ugliness, winning the Special Jury Prize at the Venice International Film Festival and earning acclaim as a masterpiece. Starring Anne Wiazemsky, who later appeared in many Godard films including "La Chinoise," in her film debut. First theatrically released in Japan in 1970, and again in 1995 distributed by France Eigasha. Revived in October 2020 in a 4K restored digital remaster. Also revived in 2026 as part of "Robert Bresson Masterpiece Selection."

tmdb_overview_en: Michel takes up pickpocketing on a lark and is arrested soon after. His mother dies shortly after his release, and despite the objections of his only friend, Jacques, and his mother's neighbor Jeanne, Michel teams up with a couple of petty thieves in order to improve his craft. With a police inspector keeping an eye on him, Michel also tries to get a straight job, but the temptation to steal is hard to resist.
director_jp: ロベール・ブレッソン
synopsis_en: Michel, a poor university student, discovers by chance that he has a talent for pickpocketing. Though once caught by a detective, he is released due to lack of evidence and soon targets others' wallets again. Eventually, his methods become organized as he brings in accomplices. In 'A Man Escaped,' Bresson realistically and thrillingly depicted a prison break; here, he turns his focus to pickpocketing, introducing actual techniques while portraying a lonely young man distrustful of others. A gripping masterpiece where the realism born from amateur actors and the suspense created by various pickpocketing scenes blend seamlessly.

synopsis_en: The 13th feature film by French master director Robert Bresson, who left behind masterpieces such as "Resistance: From the Prisoner's Diary" and "Mouchette." Bresson, already over 80 at the time of filming, passed away in 1999, making this his final work. Based on the novella "The Forged Coupon" by Russian literary giant Leo Tolstoy, it depicts the life of Yvon, a young fuel delivery man who, after unknowingly using a counterfeit bill that falls into his hands, triggers a family massacre and spirals downward. The title "L'argent" means "money" in French. First released in Japan in 1986. Revived in 2011 as part of "Cinema Masterpiece Selection III: The Art of Robert Bresson" with new prints. In 2026, it will be revived again in a 2K restored version as part of "Robert Bresson Masterpiece Selection."

tmdb_overview_en: Jacques, a young man with artistic aspirations, spends four nights wandering Paris with a young woman, whom he rescued from suicide.
director_jp: ロベール・ブレッソン
synopsis_en: Jacques, an aspiring painter, saves a young woman named Marthe from throwing herself into the Seine one night. She had a lover who left for America a year ago, and that very night was when they had promised to reunite. Jacques finds her, sunk in anguish, beautiful. Driven by a fierce impulse of love, he forces himself to remain calm, hoping her heart will drift away from her lover, while feeling guilt over this. Like the 1957 version, this is a modern adaptation of Dostoevsky's famous tragic love story, a poignant work revealing Bresson's awakened worldview. Visconti's romanticism is absent here; the young man's blind love is brutally exposed as he pours out his feelings into a mini tape recorder, a habit of his, making it painful to watch.

movie_title_original: Amélie et la métaphysique des tubes
synopsis_en: An animated film set in 1960s Kobe, depicting the growth of Amélie, a Belgian girl born in Japan. Based on the autobiographical novel "Tube Metaphysics" by Belgian writer Amélie Nothomb, it portrays a world rich in emotion, seen through the eyes of the two-year-old protagonist Amélie, woven with life, color, and her witty words. In 1960s Kobe, Amélie, a Belgian girl born into a diplomat's family, is unresponsive until age two and a half, but then enters an invincible childhood, believing herself to be a god and living in a magical world. Her days with her beloved housekeeper Nishio and her family are adventures full of new discoveries. One day, she learns the kanji for "rain," which suits her perfectly. Then, on her third birthday, an event occurs that changes everything. Directed by Myriam Ballard and Liang-Cho Han, who worked on "Long Way North," with music by Japanese composer Mari Fukuhara. It won the Audience Award at the 2025 Annecy International Animated Film Festival and was nominated for Best Animated Feature at the 98th Academy Awards.

synopsis_en: A Korean survival panic action film depicting the terror and chaos caused by the sudden outbreak of a mysterious virus spreading aboard a high-speed train connecting Seoul and Busan. Seok-woo, a fund manager working in Seoul, is separated from his wife and lives with his young daughter Su-an. Su-an insists on going alone to meet her mother in Busan for her birthday, and Seok-woo reluctantly agrees to escort her. They board the KTX high-speed train from Seoul to Busan, but just before departure, a suspicious commotion occurs near Seoul Station. A woman infected with the mysterious virus also boards KTX train 101, the same train as the father and daughter. Alongside the protagonist Seok-woo and his daughter, various passengers—a pregnant woman and her husband, high school baseball players, and a selfish middle-aged businessman—face a life-or-death struggle for survival in a state of extremity where being caught by the infected means certain death, and their individual human dramas unfold. This is the first live-action feature film by Yeon Sang-ho, a rising director who has garnered attention in the Korean animation scene, and the story preceding this film is revealed in the animated feature 'Seoul Station'.

movie_title: 少女ムシェット 4Kレストア
director: ロベール・ブレッソン
country: フランス
tmdb_overview_jp: 14歳のムシェット。家庭の貧困と父の暴力と、同級生の豊かさと美しさ、そして土曜の午後のカンタータの練習に痛めつけられる少女。森番の洩らす秘密を知って、約束を守ると誓ったのに犯されてしまう無垢な肉体。しかし、その秘密すらただの幻影に過ぎなかったと分かって、少女は完全な孤立を味わう。そんな彼女に残された選択は……。ブレッソンが、「田舎司祭の日記」の原作者G・ベルナノスの小説を、自ら脚色して映画化。
tmdb_overview_en: A young girl living in the French countryside suffers constant indignities at the hand of alcoholism and her fellow man.
director_jp: ロベール・ブレッソン
synopsis_en: Master filmmaker Robert Bresson's eighth feature, made right after his masterpiece "Au Hasard Balthazar." Based on a novel by French author Georges Bernanos, it starkly and realistically depicts the tragic fate of a young girl through rigorous framing and the actors' minimally restrained performances. 14-year-old Mouchette lives in the French countryside, forced to run the household for her alcoholic father and ill mother, while being cruelly treated by classmates and teachers at school. The unfortunate girl's fate takes a turn for the worse when, one rainy night, she encounters a poacher in the forest, sending her spiraling into further misery and ruin. Nadine Nortier, discovered for this role, plays the protagonist Mouchette, a girl standing on the brink of despair yet harboring a rebellious spirit. Produced in 1967, it was first released in Japan in 1974 by Equipe de Cinema, and again in 1995 by France Eiga Sha. A 4K restored digital remastered version had a revival release in October 2020. Another revival release is scheduled for 2026 as part of the "Robert Bresson Masterpiece Selection."

tmdb_overview_jp: 1967年に発表された安部公房の同名小説を、翌年勅使河原宏監督が映画化。勝プロダクションの共同製作で勝新太郎が主演を務め、役者として新境地を開いた異色の問題作。  燃えつきた地図 不意に失踪した夫の行方を捜してほしい、とその妻から依頼された、とある興信所の探偵。しかし、男の妻は夫の行方捜しにさほど熱心でも協力的でもなく、わずかな手がかりを頼りに探偵は調査を続けるが、男の足取りはなかなかつかめない。男と同じ会社に勤める部下の田代から、男にはヌード写真の趣味があったと知らされ、探偵は田代の案内でヌードスタジオを訪れるが、自分の話は嘘だった、と田代は告白すると自殺してしまい……。

tmdb_overview_en: Goro (Tetsuya Watari) wants to put his dark past behind. synopsis: 原作は手塚治虫の「ぼくの孫悟空」。手塚はキャラクター設定やストーリーボードを手がけ、念願のアニメーション制作に初めて携わった。準備段階で離脱したものの、手塚が志向した現代的な作風は随所に活かされている。石ノ森章太郎と月岡貞夫が手塚の助手として参加し、原画の一部も担った月岡は作画のスピードと表現力で周囲を驚かせた。
tmdb_overview_jp: 手塚治虫の「ぼくの孫悟空」をベースに、東映動画初期一回目の黄金時代に若い芸術家たちのエネルギーが結集した 痛快娯楽大作。ストーリーボードを手塚治虫自信陣頭に立って描き、また現場のスタッ フには、のちにわが国のアニメーション界を背負うことになる優秀な人材が大挙参加してい るというのも見過ごせない。いわば日本のアニメーション映画の原点のひとつ、娯楽的側面 でその将来を大き く展望させた記念碑的作品。ヴェネチア国際児童映画祭特別大賞
tmdb_overview_en: A monkey king who learns the secrets of magic goes on a spree and causes no end of aggravation for the gods, who finally imprison him. In order to make up for all the trouble he's caused, he is sent on a mission to accompany a prince who is the son of the gods on a journey through a land filled with dangers, monsters, cannibals and demons.
synopsis_en: A rousing entertainment masterpiece based on Osamu Tezuka's "My Son Goku," bringing together the energy of young artists during the first golden age of Toei Animation. It is noteworthy that Osamu Tezuka himself took the lead in drawing the storyboards, and the on-site staff included a large number of talented individuals who would later carry the future of Japan's animation industry. In other words, it is one of the origins of Japanese animated films, a monumental work that greatly envisioned the future of the medium from an entertainment perspective. Winner of the Special Grand Prize at the Venice International Children's Film Festival.

movie_title: わんぱく王子の大蛇退治
synopsis: 美術の小山礼司が平面性を重視したキャラクター造形と背景美術を提案し、日本神話の幻想的な世界が創造された。新東宝の助監督だった芹川有吾の初演出作で、森康二が作画監督を務めた。作画監督は絵柄の統一を図る重要な役職であり、本作以降、日本のアニメーションに定着していく。大塚康生と月岡貞夫が作画に半年を費やした大蛇退治の見せ場は、傑出したカメラワークとアクションで知られる。
tmdb_overview_jp: わんぱく王子・スサノオ少年が、そそっかしい兎のアカハナや大男のタイタンボウをお供に、幻想の島・オノゴロ島から海底の夜オス国、火の国、天の国・タカマガ原などを巡り、不思議な冒険を繰り広げ、最後に、ヤマタノオロチと壮絶な空中戦を展開した末にこれを退治し、美少女・クシナダ姫を救うのであった。
tmdb_overview_en: In this influential cult-classic animated film based on Japanese folklore, Susano is the youngest son of Izanagi and Izanami, the heavenly couple who created the Earth. Still a young boy, Susano is devastated by the passing away of his mother. Determined to find her despite the reprimands of his father, he embarks on a journey to find his brother and his sister for spiritual guidance.

movie_title_en: The Little Prince and the Eight-Headed Dragon
synopsis_en: The sixth feature-length anime from Toei Animation, this adventure fantasy humorously explores Japanese mythology. In the age of the gods long ago, Prince Susanoo, born to Izanagi and Izanami, enjoys happy days on Onogoro Island. One day, his mother Izanami dies. Unable to accept her death, Susanoo sets out with a rabbit named Akahana on a journey to Yomi-no-Kuni, the land of the dead where his mother is said to be. After adventures in the Night Land ruled by his brother Tsukuyomi and Takamagahara ruled by his sister Amaterasu, Susanoo arrives in Izumo Province. There, to save the princess Kushinada, he decides to fight the Yamata-no-Orochi. This was the directorial debut of Yugo Serikawa, later known for the 'Cyborg 009' series, with original animation direction by Koji Mori. The Orochi battle scene, which took Yasuo Otsuka and Sadao Tsukioka six months to complete, is celebrated as one of the greatest moments in Japanese animation history. The music was composed by Akira Ifukube, known for 'Godzilla'.

country: ソ連 原題または英題：Dievouchshka s Korobkoi The Girl with a Hatbox

tmdb_overview_jp: サイレントならではの軽やかでコミカルな動きが画面いっぱいに広がる、初期バルネットのキュートなコメディ。 帽子作りのナターシャは、モスクワの帽子店に帽子を卸している。ある時、帽子店へ行く列車の中で貧しい学生イリヤと出会い、彼がモスクワで住む部屋を確保してあげるため偽装結婚する。ある日、帽子店の亭主に代金のかわりに渡された宝くじが当たったことで、さあ大変！その男がくじを奪回しようと血眼になり、さらにイリヤとの恋の行方もからんで、ナターシャをめぐる大騒動が巻き起こる。
tmdb_overview_en: A Moscow hat shop girl chances upon a penniless young man who has arrived from the countryside for university and takes pity on him.
synopsis_en: A cute comedy from early Barnet featuring light and comical movements that fill the screen, a hallmark of silent films. Natasha, a hat maker, supplies hats to a shop in Moscow. One day, on a train to the hat shop, she meets a poor student named Ilya and enters into a fake marriage to secure him a place to live in Moscow. One day, a lottery ticket given to her by the shop owner instead of payment turns out to be a winner, and chaos ensues! The man becomes desperate to reclaim the ticket, and with the course of her romance with Ilya also in the mix, a great commotion erupts around Natasha.

tmdb_overview_jp: 1967年に発表された安部公房の同名小説を、翌年勅使河原宏監督が映画化。勝プロダクションの共同製作で勝新太郎が主演を務め、役者として新境地を開いた異色の問題作。  燃えつきた地図 不意に失踪した夫の行方を捜してほしい、とその妻から依頼された、とある興信所の探偵。しかし、男の妻は夫の行方捜しにさほど熱心でも協力的でもなく、わずかな手がかりを頼りに探偵は調査を続けるが、男の足取りはなかなかつかめない。男と同じ会社に勤める部下の田代から、男にはヌード写真の趣味があったと知らされ、探偵は田代の案内でヌードスタジオを訪れるが、自分の話は嘘だった、と田代は告白すると自殺してしまい……。
tmdb_overview_en: A private detective is hired to find a missing man by his wife. While his search is unsuccessful, the detective's own life begins to resemble the man for whom he is searching.
synopsis_en: A detective (Katsu) is hired by a mysterious woman (Ichihara) to search for her missing husband, only to find himself drawn into a bizarre situation. Ichihara delivers a commanding performance as a formidable femme fatale opposite Katsu.

program_title: 神保町シアターセレクション 女優魂2026 ——忘れられない「この1本」
tmdb_overview_en: Goro (Tetsuya Watari) wants to put his dark past behind. He heads to Hirosaki City to offer his condolences to Yumeko and to reunite with Yukiko (Chieko Matsubara), but finds that Yumeko is fatally ill. Although Yukiko was taking care of her, she is pressed for money. Goro wants to help and knows that there is only one way to come up with fast money.
synopsis_en: The second entry in Wataru's acclaimed 'Burai' series. Ashikawa, near retirement, gives a deeply emotional performance as an unfortunate woman reduced to being a yakuza's mistress, making this an unforgettable film.

program_title: 神保町シアターセレクション 女優魂2026 ——忘れられない「この1本」
tmdb_overview_en: A young girl is being asked about a man with whom she was keeping company, as her grandmother plays a lament on a shamisen. Then the focus changes to a couple arriving from Tokyo - the woman returning to her home, the man an escapee from the yakuza. The man doesn't seem to mind when the woman sells her favours to tourists at the local bar, just as she seems to take his attentions to Yuki, a blind girl, with equanimity.
synopsis_en: Set against the wintry Sea of Japan and the resonance of Tsugaru shamisen, this is a tale of reckless men and women. Enami won the Kinema Junpo Best Actress Award for this film, which also took first place in the Best Picture category.

synopsis: 1972年、中国から2頭のパンダが贈呈され、日本は空前のパンダブームに湧いた。その渦中で公開された本作は、クマの国の王子であるパンダのロンロンが、王となるべく数々の試練に挑む成長譚である。作画監督は、東映魔女っ子シリーズで多くのキャラクターデザインを手がけた高橋信也。森康二が参加した最後の東映動画作品でもある。
tmdb_overview_jp: ロンロンはクマの国の王子として生まれたが、どこでどう間違ったのかパンダであった。しかし、王子であることには変わりない。しっかりして将来の王者にふさわしい勇気と力を持って欲しいと願う母の女王クマの期待に反して、甘えん坊で弱虫とまるで見込みなし。王子としてふさわしいかどうかのテストにも失敗して、とうとうクマの国から追い出されてしまった。泣く泣く山を下っていくロンロン。ひそかに王位を狙うヒグマのデモンは、これ幸いとばかりロンロンを亡きものにするためポン太にその後を追わせた。町に出たロンロンは、一緒のピンチ共々捕まってサーカスに入れられてしまう。変な服を着せられ、厳しく芸を仕込まれるロンロン。ポン太がそのサーカスのカーテンに火をつけた。燃え上がるテント。助けを求める動物たちの声に、ロンロンは燃えるテントの中に飛び込んだ。
tmdb_overview_en: A young panda prince is found unworthy by his mother the Queen, and expelled from the forest. In his journey, he battles dangerous enemies and gets captures and forced to work in a circus.
synopsis_en: In 1972, two pandas were gifted from China, and Japan was swept by an unprecedented panda boom. Released amid that frenzy, this film is a coming-of-age tale of Ron Ron, a panda prince of the Bear Kingdom, who faces numerous trials to become king. The animation director was Nobuya Takahashi, who designed many characters in the Toei Magical Girl series. It is also the last Toei Animation film in which Koji Mori participated.

movie_title: ’87お年玉 東映まんがまつり（ゲゲゲの鬼太郎 激突!! 異次元妖怪の大反乱／ドラゴンボール 神龍の伝説／キン肉マン 正義超人VS戦士超人）
synopsis: 1963年に一部劇場で『わんわん忠臣蔵』にTVアニメ「狼少年ケン」の再編集版を併映したことを契機に、春夏を基本として年２回のアニメ、特撮などの子供向け作品をまとめた興行が定着した。名称は変遷があるものの1969年春以降は「東映まんがまつり」に固定され、1990年春以降は特撮を分離し「東映アニメまつり」「東映アニメフェア」として開催された。1986年12月の「’87お年玉 東映まんがまつり」はアニメ作品のみで構成される。「ゲゲゲの鬼太郎」はTVアニメ第3作の劇場版で妖怪が怪気象を使って国会議事堂を占拠する物語で、劇中に水木しげる夫妻が登場する。「ドラゴンボール」はTVアニメ本篇とパラレルストーリーとなる劇場版1作目。「キン肉マン」は劇場版7作目で唯一のスタンダードサイズとなる。
synopsis_en: Beginning in 1963 when a re-edited version of the TV anime "Wolf Boy Ken" was screened alongside "Wanwan Chushingura" at some theaters, screenings that bundled children's works such as anime and special effects films became established, held twice a year in spring and summer. Though the name changed over time, it was fixed as "Toei Manga Matsuri" from spring 1969, and from spring 1990, special effects works were separated, and it was held as "Toei Anime Matsuri" and "Toei Anime Fair." The December 1986 "'87 Otoshidama Toei Manga Matsuri" consisted solely of anime works. "GeGeGe no Kitaro" is a theatrical version of the third TV anime series, telling the story of yokai using strange weather to occupy the National Diet Building, with Shigeru Mizuki and his wife appearing in the film. "Dragon Ball" is the first theatrical film, set as a parallel story to the TV anime. "Kinnikuman" is the seventh theatrical film and the only one in standard (4:3) format.

synopsis: 重厚なドラマを求めた東映本社幹部陣により、田中澄江が脚本に招かれた。貴族の姉弟が奴隷に身を落とし、その受難を立身出世によって克服する物語に対し、アニメーターたちは社会の権力構造にあまりに無自覚であると強く反発したが、背景と人物が見事に調和した大和絵のような映像は息を呑む美しさを湛えている。
tmdb_overview_en: After their father quarrels with local military men, Anju and Zushio are forced to flee, but they are captured and sold into slavery. When their mother dies, they are sold to Sansho the Bailiff, a cruel man who subjects them to hideous torments. While Anju falls into a lake and is transformed into a swan, Zushio escapes and after being adopted to a nobleman grows to a young man. He will then fight to defeat the evil Dayu and free all the slaves.
synopsis_en: Summoned by Toei's top brass seeking a weighty drama, screenwriter Sumie Tanaka was brought on board. The story follows aristocratic siblings reduced to slavery, overcoming their suffering through social advancement. Animators strongly objected to the narrative's obliviousness to societal power structures, yet the breathtakingly beautiful Yamato-e style visuals, where backgrounds and characters harmonize perfectly, captivate the viewer.

synopsis_en: Episodes marked with ★ will be followed by a talk event (approx. 30 minutes) featuring Junichi Sato (animation director), Hiroki Shibata (animation director), and Daisuke Nishio (animation director).

tmdb_overview_en: A study in contrasts set in and around Havana that explores Cuba's 1959 revolution: a young woman's fascination with the excess of an American-owned casino leads to her downfall in the eyes of her street vendor boyfriend; a tenant farmer revolts the only way he knows how, attacking the land he works; university students gain first-hand knowledge of political upheaval; and, in the hills outside the city, the members of a poor peasant family are patriotically swept up into the burgeoning revolt.

tmdb_overview_en: A private detective is hired to find a missing man by his wife. While his search is unsuccessful, the detective's own life begins to resemble the man for whom he is searching.
synopsis_en: A detective (Katsu) is hired by a mysterious woman (Ichihara) to search for her missing husband, only to find himself drawn into a bizarre situation. Ichihara delivers a commanding performance as a formidable femme fatale opposite Katsu.

synopsis: かいせつ 渡の代表作「無頼」シリーズの第二作。ヤクザの情婦に身を落とした薄幸な女を、引退間際の芦川が情感たっぷりに演じ、忘れ難い1本とした。

tmdb_overview_en: Goro (Tetsuya Watari) wants to put his dark past behind. Although Yukiko was taking care of her, she is pressed for money. Goro wants to help and knows that there is only one way to come up with fast money.
synopsis_en: The second entry in Wataru's acclaimed 'Burai' series. Ashikawa, near retirement, gives a deeply emotional performance as an unfortunate woman reduced to being a yakuza's mistress, making this an unforgettable film.

tmdb_overview_en: A young girl is being asked about a man with whom she was keeping company, as her grandmother plays a lament on a shamisen. Then the focus changes to a couple arriving from Tokyo - the woman returning to her home, the man an escapee from the yakuza. The man doesn't seem to mind when the woman sells her favours to tourists at the local bar, just as she seems to take his attentions to Yuki, a blind girl, with equanimity.
synopsis_en: Set against the wintry Sea of Japan and the resonance of Tsugaru shamisen, this is a tale of reckless men and women. Enami won the Kinema Junpo Best Actress Award for this film, which also took first place in the Best Picture category.
