movie_title_en: Little Remi and Famous Dog Capi
synopsis_en: Based on 'Nobody's Boy.' Even after being sold by his stepfather to traveling performers, young Remi never loses heart. The background art incorporates elements from diverse European masterpieces by Millet and Monet, while Yugo Serikawa's masterful use of dramatic pauses heightens the arduous journey. Frankie Sakai's voice performance as Remi's sidekick Capi, with his playful demeanor, offers a refreshing respite amid the relentless tragedy.

synopsis_en: The fifth theatrical film of the TV anime in which Kinnikuman, prince of Kinniku Planet, battles evil choujins in pro wrestling. When lightning suddenly strikes Toei Uzumasa Movie Village, Kinnikuman time-travels to the Edo period, and to save a princess, he and the Seigi Choujins face off against Shuten Doji. Directed by Takenori Kawata, who also served as series director in the middle of the series, this work is heavy on comedy packed with period drama gags.

synopsis_en: The only fairy tale adaptation directed by Nishizawa Nobutaka. What is the mission entrusted to the younger sister Elisa to turn her brothers, who were transformed into swans by a witch's daughter, back into humans? Elisa's pitiful yet steady hands as she weaves nettle shirts lend a powerful realism to this fantastical story. Miyazaki Kyōko, an actress also known as the wife of Nakadai Tatsuya, wrote the screenplay under the name Takaba.

synopsis: 劇場版3作目。強大な力を持つ太陽神アベルが復活し、その妹アテナは一緒に戦ってきた主人公たちを捨ててアベルと共に去る。いつもは活発な主人公が涙を流す演出は、少年の純真さや脆さを強調している。TVアニメで死亡した5人の「黄金聖闘士」たちが復活するのも見どころ。「週刊少年ジャンプ」創刊20周年として75分の拡大版となり『魁!! 男塾』と併映された。

tmdb_overview_jp: アテナの兄、伝説の太陽神アベルが復活。地上世界を神々の手に委ねるため、大洪水を起こして人類を粛清することを目論む。それを阻止せんとしたアテナ・城戸沙織は、逆にアベルの手により死の国へ墜とされてしまう。アテナを救うために聖域の禁断の地ディグニティヒルに乗り込む星矢たちだが、彼らの行く手を十二宮戦で死んだはずのサガたち黄金聖闘士、そして神話の時代からアベルを守るコロナの聖闘士たちが阻む。かつてない強敵を迎え、星矢たちの最大の激戦が始まる。
tmdb_overview_en: The Sun God Abel returns to life, bent on punishing the humans and cleansing Earth from their presence. When Athena joins him, leaving humans to their fate, the Bronze Saints must defend the world in their greatest battle yet.

synopsis_en: The third theatrical film. The immensely powerful sun god Abel is resurrected, and his sister Athena abandons the protagonists who have fought alongside her to leave with Abel. The scene where the usually energetic protagonist sheds tears emphasizes the boy's purity and fragility. The revival of the five "Gold Saints" who died in the TV anime is also a highlight. As part of the 20th anniversary of "Weekly Shōnen Jump," this was released as a 75-minute extended version, double-billed with "Sakigake!! Otokojuku."

synopsis: 東映時代劇の隆盛を背景として製作された長篇アニメーション第2作。殺陣には東映京都撮影所屈指の擬斗・足立伶二郎を配し、豪快なアクションを得意とした大工原章が演出と原画を兼任した。入社直後の高畑勲、池田宏、黒田昌郎、小田部羊一らが初めて作品制作に参加している。日本初のシネマスコープによる長篇アニメーションでもある。
tmdb_overview_en: Magically gifted boy Sasuke lives in peace, deep in the forest with his animal pals and Oyu, his elder sister. After their forest sanctuary is violated by a demon witch who devours one of Sasuke's animal companions, he vows vengeance. Leaving the forest, he sets out to master his magical gifts, making a pilgrimage to the home of the wizard Hakuunsai. While Sasuke learns the ways of magic, the demon witch terrorizes the countryside, and Sasuke works to complete his training in time.
synopsis_en: The second feature-length animation produced against the backdrop of the flourishing Toei period drama genre. For the sword-fighting scenes, Reijiro Adachi, a top action choreographer at Toei Kyoto Studio, was brought in, and Daikuhara Akira, known for dynamic action, handled both direction and key animation. Newcomers including Isao Takahata, Hiroshi Ikeda, Masao Kuroda, and Yoichi Kotabe participated in production for the first time. It is also Japan's first feature-length animation in CinemaScope.

synopsis: 原作は𠮷田聡の同名マンガ。東映ビデオがOVAで全12巻を発売し、撮影には劇場用アニメーションと同じ35mmフィルムが用いられた。刺すような透過光が湘南の太陽を的確に表現し、ひときわ鮮やかな青空を生んだ色彩設計は、公道を爆走する高校生たちの3年間の、ともすれば殺伐と誤解されがちな刹那の青春を生き生きと彩っている。『湘南爆走族Ⅲ 10オンスの絆』のみ劇場公開された。
synopsis_en: Based on the manga of the same name by Satoshi Yoshida. Toei Video released all 12 volumes as OVAs, and 35mm film—the same used for theatrical animation—was used for shooting. The piercing transmitted light accurately captures the Shonan sun, and the color design that produced strikingly vivid blue skies vividly colors the fleeting youth of high school students speeding on public roads over three years—a time often misconstrued as brutal. Only 'Shonan Bousouzoku III: 10 Ounces of Bonds' was released theatrically.

synopsis: 男の中の男を育てる学校「男塾」での過激な訓練や戦いを描く。夏休みに世界の代表が覇を競う「ビッグバトル・オーガスト」に招待された1号生たちは、ハワイ、ナイアガラの滝、アラスカ、ニューヨークへと転戦し、アメリカチームとの決戦へと挑む。マッシブな身体描写とダイナミックな展開が魅力。
tmdb_overview_en: Momotaro and Hidemaro are 1st-years at Otokojuku, a private boys school where true men are made. Momotaro, proficient in academics and martial arts becomes good friends with Hidemaro an underachieving weakling. Omito Date, former student leader, plans his revenge against his former school. Now leader of an evil army from rival Kanto Gogakuren school he fully intends on taking over Otokojuku.
synopsis_en: Depicts the extreme training and battles at 'Otokojuku,' a school that raises men among men. Invited to the 'Big Battle August' tournament where representatives from around the world compete for supremacy during summer vacation, the first-year students fight their way through Hawaii, Niagara Falls, Alaska, and New York, culminating in a decisive battle against the American team. The appeal lies in the massive physiques and dynamic storytelling.

synopsis: OVAはTV放送が難しい暴力描写や際どいセリフの受け皿にもなり、当時大流行していた不良マンガにとって格好のメディアだった。ブームの筆頭で、ハードでありながらギャグも徹底した痛快な青春活劇である本作は、OVAでは他校との抗争を中心としたエピソードが選ばれている。キャラクターデザインは羽山淳一。ジェームス藤木による楽曲群も絶品だ。
synopsis_en: The OVA served as a vessel for violent depictions and risqué dialogue that were difficult to air on TV, making it an ideal medium for the delinquent manga that were hugely popular at the time. This work, at the forefront of the boom—a thrilling youth action piece that was hard-hitting yet thoroughly comedic—selected episodes centered on conflicts with other schools for its OVA release. Character designs were by Junichi Hayama. The musical tracks by James Fujiki are also exquisite.

synopsis_en: Based on the manga of the same name serialized in Monthly Asuka, the first installment depicts the battle between protagonist Asuka Kugura and her former underworld organization 'Zen'naka Ura,' while the second installment portrays a betting tournament orchestrated by a party company. The era's scenery—Kabukicho, the front of Koma Theater, Roppongi—is vividly captured. Directed by Atsunori Umezawa, who would go on to helm many works with female protagonists. Animation direction was handled by Yuri Handa for the first installment and Hideyuki Motohashi for the second.

synopsis: 石川英輔の小説「SF西遊記」が原案で、デザインは松本零士が手掛けた。枯渇したギャラクシーエナジーを回復するためオーロラ姫一行は銀河の中心「大王星」へ向かう。お供はクーゴ、ハッカ、ジョーゴの3人のサイボーグ。銀角のひょうたんはブラックホールに、筋斗雲は小型戦闘機に翻案され、荒くれ者のクーゴは姫に見放されて追放される。シリーズ後半に登場するベラミスは美形キャラとして人気を博した。全64話。継続して、「SF西遊記 スタージンガーⅡ」全9話が放送された。
synopsis_en: Based on Eisuke Ishikawa's novel 'SF Saiyuki,' with designs by Leiji Matsumoto. To restore the depleted Galaxy Energy, Princess Aurora and her party head to 'Daiōsei' at the center of the galaxy. Her companions are three cyborgs: Kūgo, Hakka, and Jōgo. Ginkaku's gourd is adapted into a black hole, the kintoun cloud into a small fighter craft, and the rough-and-tumble Kūgo is abandoned and banished by the princess. Bellamis, appearing in the latter half of the series, gained popularity as a handsome character. 64 episodes total. Subsequently, 'SF Saiyuki Starzinger II' aired for 9 episodes.

synopsis: 原作は赤塚不二夫。全90話で、第78話からはカラー放送となった。田島実がキャラクターデザインを担当し、高畑勲が最終話を含む9話で演出を手掛けている。下町の人情劇らしい趣を湛えながら、赤塚節全開の破天荒なギャグワールドが繰り広げられる。強烈な個性を放つキャラクターたちを、原作の持ち味そのままに演じた声優たちの貢献も大きい。
synopsis_en: Original work by Fujio Akatsuka. 90 episodes total, with color broadcasting beginning from episode 78. Minoru Tajima handled character designs, and Isao Takahata directed 9 episodes including the finale. While carrying the charm of a working-class neighborhood human drama, it unfolds Akatsuka's signature style of unbridled, outrageous gag comedy. The voice actors, who performed the intensely distinctive characters true to the original's flavor, also contributed greatly.

synopsis: 1972年、中国から2頭のパンダが贈呈され、日本は空前のパンダブームに湧いた。その渦中で公開された本作は、クマの国の王子であるパンダのロンロンが、王となるべく数々の試練に挑む成長譚である。作画監督は、東映魔女っ子シリーズで多くのキャラクターデザインを手がけた高橋信也。森康二が参加した最後の東映動画作品でもある。
tmdb_overview_jp: ロンロンはクマの国の王子として生まれたが、どこでどう間違ったのかパンダであった。しかし、王子であることには変わりない。しっかりして将来の王者にふさわしい勇気と力を持って欲しいと願う母の女王クマの期待に反して、甘えん坊で弱虫とまるで見込みなし。王子としてふさわしいかどうかのテストにも失敗して、とうとうクマの国から追い出されてしまった。泣く泣く山を下っていくロンロン。ひそかに王位を狙うヒグマのデモンは、これ幸いとばかりロンロンを亡きものにするためポン太にその後を追わせた。町に出たロンロンは、一緒のピンチ共々捕まってサーカスに入れられてしまう。変な服を着せられ、厳しく芸を仕込まれるロンロン。ポン太がそのサーカスのカーテンに火をつけた。燃え上がるテント。助けを求める動物たちの声に、ロンロンは燃えるテントの中に飛び込んだ。
tmdb_overview_en: A young panda prince is found unworthy by his mother the Queen, and expelled from the forest. In his journey, he battles dangerous enemies and gets captures and forced to work in a circus.
synopsis_en: In 1972, two pandas were gifted from China, and Japan was swept by an unprecedented panda boom. Released amid that frenzy, this film is a coming-of-age tale of Ron Ron, a panda prince of the Bear Kingdom, who faces numerous trials to become king. The animation director was Nobuya Takahashi, who designed many characters in the Toei Magical Girl series. It is also the last Toei Animation film in which Koji Mori participated.

tmdb_overview_jp: 慶応3（1867）年11月13日。雨降る京都の街並みを走るひとりの男がいた。彼の名は、坂本龍馬。土佐藩を脱藩して海援隊を組織し、薩長同盟の斡旋にも尽力した彼の奔走のおかげで、ひと月前の10月14日、大政奉還がついに実現。日本の体制は大きく変わりつつあったが、それを快く思わない連中が、龍馬の命を付け狙っていた。龍馬の元の同志である陸援隊隊長・中岡慎太郎も、龍馬を自らの手で殺すかどうか、大いに悩む。
tmdb_overview_en: Story of the last three days in the life of Sakamoto Ryoma (1836-1867), the imperial loyalist who tried to unite the Choshu and Satsuma clans and prepared the way for the Meiji Restoration (1868).
synopsis_en: A distinctive late-Edo period drama depicting the three days leading up to Ryoma's assassination from a fresh angle. Among a cast emblematic of the era, including Harada and Yusaku, Nakagawa also makes his presence felt.
